jobs.excerpt: Sobre el rolEn DaCodes buscamos un/a Senior Product Manager – Delivery / Client Solutions & AI para liderar proyectos digitales desde el entendimiento inicial del problema hasta la definición y entrega de la solución.
jobs.description:
Sobre el rol

En DaCodes buscamos un/a Senior Product Manager – Delivery / Client Solutions & AI para liderar proyectos digitales desde el entendimiento inicial del problema hasta la definición y entrega de la solución.

Este no es un rol de Product Management enfocado únicamente en administrar un backlog, ni un Project Manager centrado en ceremonias, seguimiento y tableros.

Buscamos a alguien capaz de entrar a una conversación con un cliente cuando la solución todavía no está completamente definida, entender cómo funciona su negocio y sus procesos, hacer las preguntas correctas, identificar el problema que realmente necesita resolverse y convertir ese entendimiento en una solución digital que diseño e ingeniería puedan construir.

La posición combina Product Management, Business Discovery, Client Consulting y Software Delivery, incorporando además Inteligencia Artificial como una herramienta práctica para analizar, explorar, prototipar y validar soluciones.

Reportará al Head of Project Managers y trabajará directamente con clientes, diseño y equipos de ingeniería en proyectos de software, procesos de Discovery y oportunidades relacionadas con IA.

Requirements

¿Qué harás?

Product & Business Discovery

  • Conducir sesiones de Discovery con clientes para comprender sus objetivos, operación, usuarios, procesos y problemas de negocio.
  • Convertir necesidades inicialmente ambiguas en problemas claramente definidos, funcionalidades, módulos, flujos y requerimientos accionables.
  • Analizar procesos actuales e identificar oportunidades de mejora mediante software, automatización o IA.
  • Cuestionar requerimientos cuando la solución solicitada no resuelva el problema de fondo.
  • Definir junto con UX/UI los flujos y comportamiento esperado de la solución antes de entrar a desarrollo.
  • Crear y priorizar backlog, user stories y criterios de aceptación considerando valor de negocio, riesgo, esfuerzo y viabilidad.
  • Participar en la definición de qué construir, qué no construir y por qué.

"Necesitamos a alguien que no reciba simplemente un requerimiento ya elaborado, sino que pueda descubrirlo, estructurarlo y traducirlo hacia producto y tecnología."

Client Solutions & Consulting

  • Actuar como interlocutor entre el cliente y el equipo de producto/ingeniería.
  • Facilitar workshops y sesiones con stakeholders operativos y directivos.
  • Traducir necesidades de negocio a lenguaje funcional y técnico, y hallazgos técnicos a decisiones comprensibles para el cliente.
  • Presentar alternativas de solución y explicar sus implicaciones en alcance, esfuerzo, riesgo, costo y tiempo.
  • Identificar oportunidades donde una solución digital o de IA pueda generar valor real para el cliente.
  • Mantener una relación consultiva con el cliente durante todo el proyecto, incluyendo conversaciones difíciles sobre prioridades, alcance, fechas y presupuesto.

Delivery & Project Ownership

  • Tomar ownership de proyectos digitales desde el Kick Off hasta el cierre y handover.
  • Coordinar el trabajo entre cliente, UX/UI, ingeniería y otros stakeholders.
  • Gestionar alcance, dependencias, riesgos, prioridades y desviaciones.
  • Trabajar con metodologías ágiles como Scrum y Kanban, utilizando la cadencia adecuada según las necesidades del proyecto.
  • Dar seguimiento al equipo técnico entendiendo la solución que se está construyendo, no únicamente el estatus de las tareas.
  • Detectar cambios de alcance y facilitar la evaluación de su impacto en esfuerzo, fechas y presupuesto.
  • Asegurar que el avance comunicado al cliente represente el avance real del producto.

AI aplicada al rol

Buscamos una persona que utilice IA más allá de generación de textos o documentación.

No necesitas ser AI Engineer ni tener experiencia entrenando modelos. Sí esperamos que puedas utilizar herramientas de IA como parte habitual de tu proceso de análisis y construcción de soluciones.

En la práctica, buscamos experiencia utilizando IA para:

  • Analizar y estructurar problemas complejos, información de Discovery y procesos de negocio.
  • Explorar alternativas de solución y acelerar la definición funcional de productos.
  • Construir prototipos funcionales, demos, automatizaciones, workflows o agentes que permitan validar una idea antes de comprometer desarrollo.
  • Experimentar rápidamente con una hipótesis y utilizar el resultado para tomar decisiones de producto.
  • Identificar procesos del cliente que puedan beneficiarse de automatización o soluciones basadas en IA.
  • Evaluar de manera inicial si un caso de uso de IA tiene sentido considerando impacto de negocio, viabilidad, riesgo y time-to-value.
  • Utilizar prompting estructurado y trabajar de manera iterativa, validando críticamente las respuestas generadas.
  • Utilizar IA para apoyar análisis, especificación y documentación, manteniendo siempre revisión y criterio humano sobre el resultado.

Importante: usar ChatGPT, Claude u otras herramientas únicamente para redactar correos, resumir reuniones o generar user stories NO representa por sí solo el nivel de experiencia en IA que buscamos.

Perfil:

  • 5+ años de experiencia profesional en Product Management, Product Ownership, Business Analysis, consultoría digital o gestión de proyectos de software.
  • Experiencia comprobable definiendo producto, no únicamente coordinando su ejecución.
  • Haber participado directamente en decisiones sobre qué construir, cómo priorizarlo y por qué.
  • Experiencia levantando necesidades y transformándolas en requerimientos, funcionalidades y flujos de producto.
  • Capacidad para comprender y analizar procesos de negocio.
  • Experiencia trabajando directamente con clientes externos, idealmente conduciendo Discovery, workshops o sesiones de levantamiento.
  • Experiencia trabajando de manera cercana con UX/UI y equipos de ingeniería.
  • Experiencia llevando soluciones de software desde definición hasta entrega.
  • Conocimiento suficiente de conceptos de software, integraciones y APIs para mantener conversaciones efectivas con equipos técnicos.
  • Experiencia práctica utilizando IA para análisis, prototipado, automatización o construcción/validación de soluciones.
  • Inglés B2–C1 conversacional, con capacidad para conducir sesiones de trabajo con clientes sin apoyo.

Deseable

  • Experiencia previa como Product Manager en startup, scale-up, SaaS o productos digitales.
  • Experiencia en consultoría de tecnología, producto o transformación digital.
  • Experiencia documentando y optimizando procesos mediante BPMN, process mapping, swimlanes u otras metodologías.
  • Experiencia con herramientas no-code / low-code y AI-assisted development para construir prototipos o automatizaciones.
  • Familiaridad con asistentes de desarrollo basados en IA y con la forma de trabajo de equipos de ingeniería.
  • Conocimiento general de infraestructura cloud, plataformas de terceros y costos asociados a soluciones digitales.
  • Experiencia previa en una industria o vertical específica será valorada, pero no es requisito.

El perfil que mejor puede encajar

Puedes venir de diferentes trayectorias. Nos interesa especialmente conversar con:

  • Product Managers de startups, scale-ups, SaaS o compañías de producto que hayan tenido ownership real sobre funcionalidades o productos.
  • Product Consultants / Digital Consultants acostumbrados a entender problemas de clientes y convertirlos en soluciones.
  • Senior Product Owners con fuerte exposición a negocio, cliente e ingeniería.
  • Senior Business Analysts que hayan evolucionado más allá del levantamiento de requerimientos y participado en definición de solución y producto.
  • Project Managers con experiencia demostrable tomando decisiones de producto y negocio, no únicamente gestionando delivery.

La industria de origen no es restrictiva. Nos importa más la capacidad de aprender un negocio, comprender sus procesos y convertirlos en una solución que venir de una vertical determinada.

Probablemente no sea el rol adecuado si...

  • Tu experiencia se concentra principalmente en Jira, ceremonias, seguimiento de tareas y métricas de sprint.
  • Normalmente recibes los requerimientos ya definidos y tu responsabilidad comienza a partir de ahí.
  • No has tenido participación directa en decisiones sobre qué construir o cómo resolver un problema de producto.
  • Tu experiencia con clientes ha sido principalmente de seguimiento de estatus.
  • Tu uso profesional de IA se limita a generación de textos, resúmenes, correos o user stories.
  • Buscas una posición de desarrollo o ingeniería de IA: no esperamos que esta persona escriba código productivo ni construya infraestructura/modelos de ML.

Benefits

🚀 Integración a marcas globales y startups disruptivas.

🏡 Trabajo remoto/Home office.

📍 En caso de requerir modalidad híbrida o presencial, serás informado desde la primera sesión.
⏳ Horario ajustado a la célula de trabajo/proyecto asignado.
📅 Trabajo de lunes a viernes.
🎉 Día off en tu cumpleaños.
🏥 Seguro de gastos médicos mayores (aplica para México).
🛡️ Seguro de vida (aplica para México).
🌎 Equipos de trabajo multiculturales.
🎓 Acceso a cursos y certificaciones.
📢 Meetups con invitados especiales del área de IT.
📡 Eventos virtuales de integración y grupos de interés.
📢 Clases de inglés.

jobs.title: Rev/Marketing Operations Manager
jobs.excerpt: Company Overview Agility PR Solutions is a global leader in media intelligence and PR technology.
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Agility PR Solutions is a global leader in media intelligence and PR technology. Founded in 2003, we help communications teams around the world drive awareness, make smarter decisions, and protect their reputation when it matters most. Our enterprise-grade platform unifies media relations, media monitoring, social listening, AI visibility, and media intelligence into a single seamless system—turning overwhelming streams of coverage and conversation into decision-ready intelligence. Recognized for ease of use, results, and customer support, Agility is one of the most trusted names in media intelligence. Our mission is to empower the voices that shape the world's narratives, and we're looking for people who want to help us do it.

About the Role

Reporting to the VP of Marketing, the Rev/Marketing Operations Manager owns HubSpot end to end — the instance, the data model, and the daily campaign build — and is the architect of how Agility measures marketing's impact on revenue.
Our attribution challenge is real and unsolved: our CRM lifecycle doesn't follow the textbook pattern, so conventional attribution models don't work here out of the box. You will establish HubSpot as the initial source of truth for marketing data, design a measurement approach that fits how our systems actually behave, evaluate first-touch, last-touch, and multi-touch attribution in HubSpot, and make a defensible recommendation. Just as important as building the model is explaining it: you will articulate the methodology — clearly and credibly — to the VP of Marketing, the broader organization, and our sales partners.

This is a builder's seat, not an administrator's. You will build and launch campaigns in HubSpot on a daily basis, executing on behalf of the Associate Director, Demand Generation, who sets campaign priorities and briefs; you own build quality, instance governance, and measurement truth. You will partner closely with our Salesforce Administrator on the CRM boundary.

This role reports directly to the Director of Marketing — deliberately outside the campaign organization — so that measurement remains independent and credible with every stakeholder it serves.

You will also instrument our conversational AI pilot, including capturing baseline website conversion rates before go-live, so that the pilot's impact is measured honestly from day one.

What Success Looks Like

  • A recommended attribution model (first-touch, last-touch, or multi-touch) is implemented in HubSpot, documented, and understood by marketing, sales, and leadership — with the methodology presented and defended in plain language.
  • HubSpot operates as the initial source of truth for marketing data, reconciled cleanly with the Salesforce contact structure.
  • Campaigns ship daily and weekly — on brief, on time, and to a quality standard — in support of demand generation priorities.
  • Email compliance runs clean across all regional lanes — CAN-SPAM (US), CASL (Canada), GDPR/PECR (UK-EU) — with zero compliance incidents.
  • The conversational AI pilot has a documented pre-launch conversion baseline and live measurement of its impact on conversion and meetings booked.
  • Lead scoring, routing, and lifecycle workflows are rebuilt, documented, and trusted by sales.

What You'll Do

Attribution & Measurement

  • Design and implement Agility's marketing attribution model in HubSpot, working within the realities of our CRM lifecycle rather than the textbook version.
  • Evaluate first-touch, last-touch, and multi-touch approaches; recommend one and defend the trade-offs.
  • Present the methodology and its reporting to marketing, sales, and executive stakeholders, and iterate based on what the business needs to see.
  • Build and maintain the dashboards leadership uses to make budget decisions — and be able to dissect and rebuild any dashboard from the underlying data.

Campaign Build & Execution

  • Build, QA, launch, and monitor campaigns in HubSpot daily on behalf of the Associate Director, Demand Generation: emails, nurtures, workflows, forms, landing pages, lists, and segmentation.
  • Operate the regional outbound email lanes and their differing consent regimes.
  • Own campaign build quality end to end: deliverability, rendering, tracking, and data hygiene.

Platform Governance & Compliance

  • Own the HubSpot instance: architecture, permissions, integrations, data model, naming conventions, and documentation.
  • Own compliance operations across CAN-SPAM, CASL, and GDPR/PECR, including consent management, suppression, and auditability.
  • Partner with the Salesforce Administrator on the HubSpot–Salesforce boundary: sync health, field mapping, and the lead lifecycle handoff.
  • Design and maintain routing and SLA flows for our no-SDR motion, including the chatbot-to-calendar handoff.
  • Operate the dedicated cold-outbound sending stack alongside HubSpot — domain and mailbox health, warmup, and bidirectional sync (suppression lists out, activity and replies in) — keeping true cold email off the marketing platform in line with its acceptable-use policy.
  • Maintain the data-rights workflow: a documented path to delete or suppress a contact across HubSpot, the outbound sequencer, and enrichment exports.

AI & Pilot Measurement

  • Instrument the conversational AI pilot: capture the pre-launch website conversion baseline, define success metrics, and report pilot performance.
  • Apply HubSpot's current AI capabilities — such as Breeze, AI-assisted workflows, and predictive scoring — where they demonstrably improve speed or quality.
  • Continuously evaluate new HubSpot releases and recommend adoption where warranted.

Why You'll Bring

  • Deep, hands-on HubSpot expertise — administration, campaign build, reporting, and data model — in a live production instance (Marketing Hub required; HubSpot certifications an asset).
  • Demonstrated fluency with HubSpot's current AI and agentic capabilities (for example Breeze, AI-assisted workflows, and predictive scoring), applied in production — this platform evolves monthly, and you keep pace.
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce and experience managing a HubSpot–Salesforce integration, with the comfort to design around non-standard CRM structures.
  • Proven attribution experience: you have built — not just read — attribution reporting, and you can explain the trade-offs of competing models to non-technical audiences.
  • Email compliance experience across at least two of CAN-SPAM, CASL, and GDPR.
  • Experience operating or supporting a dedicated cold-email stack — sequencer, secondary sending domains, warmup, deliverability monitoring — and syncing it cleanly with a CRM.
  • An analyst's mindset: you dissect dashboards down to the underlying data, rebuild what's broken, and treat measurement accuracy as a matter of professional pride.
  • A sense of urgency and a test-and-learn habit: you review the numbers weekly, form hypotheses, and iterate.

Why You'll Love it Here

  • Fully remote work environment
  • Collaborative culture – and key tools enabling it
  • Competitive compensation package
  • Health, Dental & Vision benefits
  • RRSP matching
  • Life Insurance
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Career Development & Progression opportunities
  • Paid Vacation, Personal Days and Sick days
  • Flex Fridays in Summer, Week off between Christmas and New Years'
  • No Internal Meetings Fridays

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is C$82,000–C$115,000 annually, plus a 10% target bonus. Final compensation will reflect the successful candidate's experience, skills, and internal equity.

This is a new position.

AI Usage

We use technology to make hiring smarter, faster, and more personal, never less human. Artificial intelligence (AI) tools help us manage applications efficiently and highlight qualifications that align with each role, allowing our recruiters to focus more on meaningful conversations with candidates. AI does not make hiring decisions at Agility. Every decision is made by people, our hiring managers and recruitment professionals, who are trained to apply sound judgment and equitable practices at every stage. We believe technology exists to amplify human insight, not replace it. That belief shapes how we build relationships, tell stories, and grow our teams.

At Agility, we strive every day to build a more inclusive work environment and introduce tools that enable it. We strongly encourage applications from all people regardless of race, religion, gender, age, disability status or sexual orientation.

Even if you find yourself not checking all the boxes of our listed requirements but you are excited about this opportunity, we'd love to hear from you anyway. Our Talent Acquisition team will review your application for this role, and other potential role matches open now or in the future.

If, at any stage of the application process, you require accommodation owing to disability or a medical need, please let us know at for us to make appropriate arrangements.

Job Title: Data Scientist

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

As a Data Scientist on the Link Key Accounts team, you'll build the models and methodologies that turn multi-source healthcare data into reliable intelligence about healthcare organizations, their networks, and the people who make decisions inside them. The work spans both ends of the spectrum: quantitative analysis of claims and financial data, and qualitative inference — building org charts and mapping influence from titles, roles, and other soft signals. This is an early, high-latitude role with room to shape both the methods and the product.

What You'll Do

    • Apply statistical and machine learning techniques to healthcare claims and other structured data to build new metrics and methodologies — for example, calculating readmissions and average length of stay across varied claims sources, producing all-payer estimates, and developing clinical ontologies
    • Transform public financial data into clear signals and a coherent story about the financial health of healthcare organizations
    • Build entity resolution and record-linkage models across health systems, provider organizations, employers, and payers
    • Develop affiliation and network mapping — inferring how organizations and people connect, and how influence and reporting structures flow across them
    • Infer organizational structure from qualitative signals, building org charts and decision-maker maps from titles, positions, and role characteristics
    • Design data-sourcing methodologies that evaluate, score, and combine heterogeneous inputs (public filings, web sources, licensed data) into accurate, defensible account signals
    • Build the models that power account targeting and segmentation — deciling, patient-volume and disease-state signals, strategic filters
    • Partner with Product, Data Engineering, Engineering, and QA to take solutions from prototype to production, then iterate and enhance

Requirements

    • 5+ years of hands-on data science and statistics experience
    • 5+ years working with healthcare data and the US healthcare system
    • Experience with healthcare claims data (medical and/or pharmacy) and the metrics derived from it
    • Experience with healthcare organizational data (HCO/HCP, IDN, GPO, payer)
    • Experience developing clinical ontologies or standardized healthcare data models
    • Experience with entity resolution, record linkage, or fuzzy matching on real-world, imperfect data
    • Track record of inferring structure from noisy, incomplete data - cleansing, experiment design, solution assessment, and scaling
    • Comfortable with ambiguity and turning goals into tangible work plans
    • Able to explain statistical and technical concepts to audiences of varying technical depth

Nice to Have

    • M.S. in Statistics, Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, or another quantitative discipline

        3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.

    • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
    • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays

5+ years of ad tech experience with a strong understanding of the mobile gaming programmatic ecosystem, including gaming publishers, SSPs, DSPs, mediation platforms, and in-app monetization infrastructure.

Deep familiarity with gaming monetization, SDK-based advertising, user acquisition economics, and programmatic advertising across iOS and Android ecosystems.

Familiarity with major gaming monetization platforms and ecosystems including:

A passion for identifying growth opportunities and solving complex monetization challenges through strategic thinking, relationship building, and data-driven recommendations.

Experience working cross-functionally with:

  • product teams,
  • engineering,
  • solutions engineering,
  • and demand teams

while effectively communicating complex concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Strong communication and relationship-building skills with experience managing executive-level publisher conversations and long-term strategic partnerships.

Highly self-motivated and comfortable operating independently in a lean, fast-paced, rapidly evolving environment.

Effective time management skills with the ability to prioritize opportunities, manage multiple strategic relationships, and maintain strong attention to detail.

Professional demeanor and excellent verbal/written communication skills across in-person meetings, conferences, video calls, email, and Slack.

  • SQO pipeline ($ and #) and closed-won revenue vs. quota

● Sales cycle timelines

Who You Are

  • 5–10 years of experience in strategic partnerships, business development, or channel leadership within payments, fintech, or SaaS.
  • Strong grasp of partner incentive structures, GTM planning, and long-cycle relationship management.
  • Excellent communicator who can translate between technical and commercial stakeholders.

  • Skilled at managing ambiguity, aligning cross-functional teams, and driving toward outcomes.
  • Confident negotiator who can design win-win partnerships.
  • Comfortable engaging with C-level decision-makers and influencing executive stakeholders.
  • Excited by building something new, with a “no task too small” mindset.
  • US work authorization (US citizens or green card holders)

You strive to uncover complex problems and find great personal and professional fulfillment in solving them.  You can put yourself into the mindset of a customer to uncover problems before an actual customer does.  In addition, you are: 

  • Team-oriented: You believe shared success and individual advancement go hand-in-hand.  We share your values.  You thrive in an inclusive, collaborative environment and hold yourself and your teammates accountable    You step up and step in when your team needs you.    
  • Impact-driven: You find deep meaning and satisfaction in making an impact.  You are self-aware about what motivates you and what instills passion.  You take pride in being trusted to deliver results for your team.  You embrace a growth-mindset.  You reframe setbacks as gifted opportunities to improve.  In short, you’re a polite, ethical hustler.  
  • Structured decision maker: you believe progress is rooted in a focused effort.  To know how to focus, you work hard to understand the root cause and listen to different points of view.  You prefer investigating to being right.  You first identify the core drivers of a problem and work backwards to simplify the solution.  You constantly think about 2nd and 3rd order effects of decisions.  In general, you are optimistically paranoid about what you don’t know.  

InterPayments’ Values:

  • Customers and mission first.  The customer is at the heart of everything we do and we have an enormous obligation to help them.  We align our company, team, and individual goals with customer outcomes and our mission.  When making

decisions and setting priorities, we always keep our customer’s perspective and our mission in mind. 

  • Always build trust.  We focus on the long-term. We treat everyone - existing and prospective teammates, customers, partners, vendors, investors - as if we’ll know and work with them forever.  We assume good intent and empathize.  We’re always ethical, respectful, and honest.  We are responsive, reliable, and trustworthy.  We are loyal and committed to one another, our customers, and our mission.  Nothing is transactional.    
  • Do the hard(er) thing.  We reject complacency and embody a growth mindset because it’s more fulfilling.  Being resilient, flexible, and adaptable is challenging.  Seeking and delivering honest feedback is hard.  Embracing open-mindedness, intellectual honesty, and respectful disagreement is tough.  Being relentlessly curious, simplifying complexity, and thinking through 2nd/3rd order effects of decisions takes more work.  Being highly responsive and making data-driven decisions requires more effort.  We choose to do them anyway.  We find reward in pushing ourselves and others beyond our comfort zones. 
Remote pay range
$110,000—$150,000 USD

InterPayments’ core values are the building blocks of how we achieve our mission: Obsess about our Customers’ and Partners’ Needs; Be Relentless, Resilient, and Responsive; Collaborate with Teammates, Customers, and Partners; Act with Integrity and Empathy; Outperform your Potential; and Communicate Honestly and Respectfully.

Remote Work Eligibility:

This position is open to candidates who are located in the United States. All remote roles are limited to U.S.- based residents, and the company does not sponsor visas or employ individuals who require work authorization outside of the United States. Only applicants who are legally authorized to work in the U.S. will be considered.

jobs.description:
About Orchid

At Orchid Software Solutions, we are dedicated to transforming the assisted reproduction, healthcare payments, and fintech industries through software designed to increase efficiency and transparency in life-changing processes. We are at a pivotal moment, moving from "building fast" to "scaling right" at 10x velocity. We are looking for a Senior Tech Lead to take ownership of one of our core product engineering pods, supporting a business-critical financial workflow within our healthcare-payments and fintech platform.

The Role: A Real Lead, Not Just a Senior Engineer

This is a leadership hire first, and a hands-on technical role second. We need someone who can genuinely lead a team, set direction, divide work effectively, mentor, and earn the trust of strong engineers, not simply the most senior coder in the room. You'll take full ownership of architecture, delivery, and team health for a distributed group of senior engineers spanning Latin America and the US.

You'll also be a technical builder: comfortable with code, able to make and defend architectural decisions, and fluent enough in AI-assisted development to set the pace for the team. But the bar for this role is proven people leadership: you've formally managed engineers before, not just been promoted into leading because you wrote the most code.

What You Will Do

  • Team Leadership: Directly lead and grow your engineering pod, a distributed team across Latin America and the US. Set technical direction, divide and prioritize work, and run the mentorship, feedback, and career-growth practices a real engineering lead owns.
  • Earn the Team's Trust: Step into a team with strong, opinionated senior engineers who expect a lead who can technically hold their own and genuinely listen.
  • The SDLC itself: Evolve how this team works — an agile practice that actually fits a distributed pod, and an agentic AI software development lifecycle with real guardrails. Define how work gets specified, reviewed, tested, and shipped when a meaningful share of the code is AI-generated. This is a named deliverable of the role.
  • Architectural Rigor: Own the architecture of our Next.js applications that power core case and workflow management, and integrations with external partner platforms, ensuring scalability and a clean separation of frontend/backend concerns.
  • Technical Modernization: Drive the migration of legacy systems (Flask/jQuery) into a modern, robust stack (Next.js/Node/TypeScript) across critical business workflows.
  • AI Productization: Design and implement RAG architectures and AI agent workflows to optimize case intake, submission review, and reconciliation. In a regulated domain this means governed and auditable by default.
  • Data Layer Ownership: Own the pipelines and data layer connecting your platform with client financial systems, lead the optimization of complex PostgreSQL/MySQL queries and ensure infrastructure scales with growth in clinical, legal, and financial records.
  • Partnership with Product: You own engineering execution and technical scope; you partner closely with your pod's Product/Project Manager and business stakeholders on sequencing, trade-offs, and what's realistic.
  • Delivery & Client Impact: Own the reliability and pace of delivery for a system where accuracy and turnaround time directly affect how our clients experience the platform.

Our Product Ecosystem & Technologies

  • Frontend: Next.js (App Router), React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
  • Backend & Infra: Node.js, Python, Go, AWS (Lambda, S3, ECS, RDS).
  • AI & Data: PostgreSQL (PgVector), MySQL, LangChain, and advanced LLM integrations.

What We're Looking For

  • Proven engineering leadership: you've formally led/managed a team of engineers before — this is a must, not a nice-to-have.
  • You've led a distributed and blended team — multiple countries, multiple time zones, a mix of employees and agency/contract staff.
  • 7+ years building and scaling production-grade web applications, with recent hands-on depth.
  • Full-stack with a backend/infra tilt: API design, microservices orchestration, database optimization, plus modern frontend fluency.
  • AI-native mindset: you use AI tools daily, and have a point of view on review, testing, security, and cost control when a machine writes a large share of the code.
  • High-impact communication: you can defend architectural trade-offs to senior leadership and represent the team credibly in high-stakes conversations.
  • Startup grit: you thrive in a fast-moving, ~100-person company.
  • Regulated-domain comfort (a plus): healthcare, fintech, or another compliance-heavy domain.

Essential Requirements

  • Must be based in the United States.
  • Ability to lead and maintain overlap with a distributed team across Latin America and the US.
  • Must pass a background check.

Why Orchid?

  • Real Impact: your work directly affects how our platform serves clients in high-stakes, regulated environments.
  • Ownership: you'll have the authority to make architectural and team decisions that stick.
  • Remote Culture: we're a fully remote team that values autonomy and clear async communication.

Commercial E&S Portfolio Performance Underwriter

Portfolio Underwriting & Optimization is a specialized department within the Contract Property & Casualty underwriting organization. The PUO team is responsible for driving profitable growth through strategic book management by applying technical underwriting expertise and various data driven analysis with the goal to identify and deliver underwriting actions that align with business strategy.

General responsibilities for a PUO underwriter include the following:

  • Management/assisting of assigned LOB/segment and identifies, coordinates, and delivers on product, appetite, and pricing optimization changes to the portfolio
  • Ensuring rate strategy implementation and execution for assigned LOB/segment
  • Utilize data tools, reporting and external resources and publications to identify trends and make recommendations to improve profitability
  • Collaborate with underwriting and agency partners to solicit feedback on new product and program opportunities
  • Collaborate with Product and technology partners to drive successful implementation of product enhancements in underwriting systems and ensure system behavior supports underwriting intent
  • Collaborate with Product on the design and development of new forms and standalone product/program offerings
  • Provide recommendations for future audits based on existing portfolio trends or retrospective portfolio reviews
  • Participate in claims roundtables, agency visits/agency calls to proactively identify, research and solution for trends/opportunities in assigned segment(s)
  • Attending industry conferences and events
  • Assist/manage Alternative Distribution book as needed.

The candidate for this role should have 6 years related experience or 5 years as an Underwriter and should have prior experience in Commercial P&C Excess & Surplus lines underwriting with:

  • Commercial E&S P&C underwriting and product knowledge
  • Ability to identify, manage and solution for trends within a book of business
  • Understanding of underwriting operations and underwriting systems
  • Familiarity with ISO and other industry resources
  • Data analysis and identifying an impact on book performance
  • Manage projects and prioritize multiple tasks under tight deadlines
  • Be a self-starter who takes initiative to improve quality, processes, and communication

  • Effective in managing ambiguity with the ability to operate under limited direction

*This role does not qualify for employer-sponsored work authorization. Nationwide does not participate in the Stem OPT Extension program.*

Job Description Summary

Are you a critical thinker who can analyze complex risk and find insurance solutions that balance customer needs with business goals? If you can take initiative, use both your analytical and creative abilities to make sound decisions and have a desire to help people solve real challenges, we want to hear from you!

Our Excess & Surplus/Specialty (E&S/S) lines allow us to provide insurance that other carriers may not offer. It’s a fast-paced environment in a collaborative, team-oriented culture, working in an always-changing, growing industry.

As an Underwriting Specialist in Contract you determine individual risk acceptability, pricing, coverage, terms and conditions, by developing, analyzing and evaluating information and exposures on risks of a complex technical nature for the assigned line of business. In addition, you’ll achieve production and loss ratio goals with assigned general agents or program managers by reviewing and analyzing claims, loss history and taking appropriate action on accounts. General agent assignments are more complex in terms of coverage and general agent relationships. It’s important to establish and maintain effective relationships with general agents to generate premium dollars and profitability. You will work independently with a high level of authority and judgment. Determining appropriate reinsurance placement, if any, on individual accounts is an important element of this role. We will count on you to foster positive business relationships with co-workers, general agents and reinsurers. You will also assist with research, development and presentation of new products, forms and manuals and have opportunities to assist in the training and mentoring of Underwriters and Underwriting Assistants.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Reviews individual risks with assigned agents or programs within assigned territory and either declines or accepts business based upon information necessary to make the decision. The underwriter analyzes, with a high level of technical expertise, exposures to loss, develops an adequate premium charge for the exposure and determines appropriate endorsements and exclusions to address loss exposures for the insurance contract. Within department guidelines, places reinsurance, if any, for the account.

  • Achieves individual production and loss ratio goals within assigned territory through sound territory management and marketing. Achieves production, profitability and service objectives. Quotes, prices and underwrites new and renewal policies and endorsements, primarily for complex or service sensitive accounts. Monitors risk selection and pricing decisions for entire agency plant, both on a book of business and individual account level basis. Works with more complex issues concerning coverage, programs, agents and program managers. The underwriter continually analyzes premium and loss results in their territory or assigned agents by agency, state, major class of business and by program. Continually assess quality of submissions and makes corrective action recommendations. Development and implementation of specific action plans may be required

  • Handles policy maintenance items and other mid-term requests. Reviews endorsement requests and processes necessary changes to the policy. Reviews loss control reports and makes recommendations to the agent and/or changes to the policy. Follows up on outstanding information as required. Reviews claim activity and takes appropriate action. May review agency books of business as well as profit/growth results and trends to recommend and implement action plans.

  • Fosters positive business relationships with general agents through daily contact with assigned agents by developing and maintaining good rapport and resolving agency conflicts. Travels to agency offices as required for audits, training or marketing visits. Entertains agents visiting the Company as required. Assists with development of marketing ideas and strategies for underwriting seminars and other marketing campaigns.

  • Places reinsurance per department guidelines based upon the appropriate use of all reinsurance facilities used by the department, including various treaty semiautomatic and facultative reinsurance. Maintains good working relationship with reinsurers.

  • Markets Nationwide products and services to help drive agency and company results, including all enterprise products that may enhance offerings. Assists agency with strategies for pipeline management, producer development and to develop new business in targeted industries and preferred markets. Responds effectively to assess accounts and develop business propositions that win the business.

  • Other responsibilities as assigned may include program research and development, form development, rate development, technical assistance to Agents, Underwriting Assistants, and other Underwriters. Proactively develops technical and business knowledge through internal and external venues

May perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Reporting Relationships: Reports to Department Manager

Typical Skills and Experiences:

Education: Undergraduate degree preferred. Equivalent work experience will be considered in lieu of a degree.

License/Certification/Designation: Completion of general insurance courses such as CPCU, CIC, AU, ARM, CPIW, CWIS, or ASLI is preferred.

Experience: Six years related experience or five years as an underwriter, excess & surplus lines preferred.

Knowledge, Abilities and Skills: Knowledge of lines underwriting policies, practices and procedures, insurance law and underwriting marketing principles and techniques, rating plans and plan concepts, Treaty & Facultative reinsurance concepts, general agency system and company operations, regulatory issues, the general agency system, market conditions and company operations. Ability to communicate effectively, orally, and in writing, interpersonally with individuals and groups via telephone, fax, e-mail and in person. Demonstrates advanced negotiation skills. Ability to manage the assigned line or lines of business, which may include monitoring of aggregates. Ability to work with the wholesale/general agency distribution system. Ability to analyze insurance risks to determine acceptability including policy language, various commercial rating plans and methodologies, reinsurance. Ability to use/learn job related computer software. Ability to devise business solutions to problems, implement the most appropriate, and monitor its effectiveness. Ability to make decisions with minimal supervision.

Other criteria, including leadership skills, competencies and experiences may take precedence.

Staffing exceptions to the above must be approved by the hiring manager’s leader and HR Business Partner.

Values: Regularly and consistently demonstrates Nationwide Values.

Job Conditions:

Overtime Eligibility: Not Eligible (Exempt)

Working Conditions: Normal office environment. Travel out of state as required several times a year. In-town entertaining required as necessary after 5:00 P.M.

jobs.description:
We're looking for an experienced recruiter who enjoys building relationships, uncovering great talent and helping teams make confident hiring decisions.

You'll take ownership of recruitment across our UK studio, partnering closely with leaders across Product, Engineering, Production, Art, Design, Creative and Operations to understand hiring needs, develop effective recruiting strategies and attract exceptional people.

Our hiring needs vary depending on the projects we're delivering and where the business is growing. At times you'll be managing permanent hiring alongside fast-moving freelance and project requirements; at others, you'll have more opportunity to focus on talent pipelines, market insight and initiatives that improve how we recruit.

You'll work with a high degree of autonomy and partner with our Talent Acquisition Director on wider hiring priorities and initiatives. Recruiting here isn't always straightforward: priorities can change, requirements aren't always fully defined, and you'll need to be comfortable navigating ambiguity, asking the right questions and using your judgement to keep things moving.

Throughout, you'll work closely with hiring managers as a trusted recruiting partner - providing perspective and insight, challenging assumptions when needed, and helping teams make great hiring decisions.

Location

    This role is open to candidates based anywhere in the UK and can be remote, hybrid or studio-based depending on your preference. Our UK studio is based in St Albans.

What you'll do

  • Manage full-cycle permanent, freelance and project recruitment across a variety of technical, creative, production, product and operational roles
  • Partner with hiring managers to understand their needs and develop effective recruiting strategies
  • Take ownership of hiring processes, keeping stakeholders informed and maintaining momentum from initial brief through to hire
  • Source and engage high-quality candidates through a variety of channels
  • Screen and assess candidates against role requirements and organisational fit
  • Guide candidates through the hiring process and provide an excellent candidate experience
  • Coordinate effective interview and assessment processes and help stakeholders make confident hiring decisions
  • Support offer creation, negotiation and onboarding activities
  • Build and maintain relationships with candidates and talent pipelines for future hiring needs
  • Develop knowledge of the disciplines and talent markets you support, providing relevant market insight and recruiting guidance to stakeholders
  • Identify potential risks or challenges within hiring processes and proactively work with stakeholders to resolve them
  • Contribute to recruiting initiatives and help us continuously improve our processes, tools and ways of working

What will help you succeed in this role

    • Strong experience managing full-cycle recruitment, ideally within the technology, creative, games or entertainment industries
    • Demonstrated success sourcing and attracting high-quality talent
    • Strong interviewing and candidate assessment skills
    • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills
    • The ability to build credibility and work effectively with stakeholders at multiple levels of an organisation
    • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple roles and priorities with a high degree of autonomy
    • Comfort navigating ambiguity and adapting your approach as priorities or requirements change
    • Good judgement, with the confidence to make decisions, identify risks and proactively suggest solutions
    • A collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively across different teams and disciplines
    • An understanding of recruitment best practices and the UK hiring landscape
    • A genuine desire to help candidates, hiring managers and colleagues succeed

Even better if you also have

  • Experience recruiting within the games, creative technology, VFX or media & entertainment industries
  • Experience recruiting both technical and creative talent across multiple disciplines
  • Experience supporting distributed or international teams
  • Experience helping to improve recruiting processes, tools or operational practices
  • Experience mentoring or supporting less experienced recruiters
  • Experience working in scaling or evolving organisations

We don't expect anyone to tick every box

    If you're excited by the opportunity to help build great teams, enjoy working with smart and creative people, and believe you could be successful in the role, we'd love to hear from you.

About Magnopus

Magnopus is an experience-focused technology company founded by a team of Oscar-winning artists, designers and engineers from the worlds of film, games and immersive media.

We create experiences that bring together storytelling, creativity and technology in new ways — from immersive attractions and interactive installations to virtual production, spatial computing, AI-powered experiences and emerging technologies. Our work helps some of the world's most recognisable brands and organisations connect with audiences in ways that weren't previously possible.

We've built experiences for millions of people around the world and continue to explore what's possible at the intersection of creativity, technology and human connection.

Though we've delivered a lot of incredible work, here are just a few examples you can explore yourself:

Metallica: Music Experience in UEFN
Mission: ISS
Alo Moves XR
World of Fallout
Daft Punk Experience, Fortnite
The Wizard of Oz at Sphere

We're proud of the work we create, but we're equally proud of how we create it. Magnopus is built around collaboration, curiosity and respect. We believe great ideas can come from anywhere, and we strive to create an environment where talented people can learn, grow and do some of the best work of their careers.

Behind every great project is a team that enables it. Whether you're supporting Finance, People, Talent Acquisition, Operations or Business Development, you'll play an important role in helping our teams do their best work and ensuring Magnopus continues to grow sustainably as a global business.

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Annual Fund Officer

Reports to:Director of Development

Team/Department:Development

Direct Reports:None

Location & Schedule:Remote | Based in or commutable to the Washington, DC area (DC/MD/VA); occasional travel to the New York area and elsewhere as needed

Compensation:$70,000–$80,000 annually, commensurate with experience, plus comprehensive benefits including health insurance, vision and dental insurance, retirement plan match, life and disability insurance, and generous paid time off.

Who We Are

Kakenya's Dream is a nonprofit organization dedicated to empowering and educating girls in rural Kenya so they can become agents of change in their communities and beyond. Through education, leadership development, health initiatives, and community engagement, we work to end harmful practices such as female genital mutilation and child marriage while creating pathways for girls to thrive.

Founded by Dr. Kakenya Ntaiya, a globally recognized advocate for girls' education, Kakenya's Dream partners with students, families, educators, community leaders, and supporters around the world to create lasting impact and expand opportunities for girls.

Kakenya's Dream is seeking an Annual Fund Officer to help execute fundraising operations totaling $3M annually, with a goal of growing the organization's fundraising budget to $4M within the next three years.

What We're Looking For

This is a dual-focus role that combines front-facing donor engagement with hands-on fundraising production: the Annual Fund Officer will build relationships and make the “ask” directly with donors and funders, while also leading grant drafting and reporting, and the design and execution of fundraising campaigns and proposals. Reporting to the Director of Development, this person will work closely with the President and Communications team to ensure the organization achieves its annual and multi-year fundraising goals.

Success in this role requires genuine comfort and confidence engaging donors face-to-face — building rapport, leading solicitation conversations, and representing Kakenya's Dream at meetings, events, and community gatherings — paired with strong writing and project management skills to draft compelling grant proposals and reports, and to design and execute multi-channel campaigns and solicitation materials. The ideal candidate is an outgoing relationship-builder who is equally energized by direct donor contact and by the strategic, written work that supports it: extremely detail-oriented, with excellent writing skills and sound judgment, and someone who thrives in a fast-paced, mission-focused environment.

The ideal candidate is someone who:

  • Is a strong writer and storyteller

  • Is a confident, natural relationship-builder who enjoys direct donor contact

  • Is comfortable managing multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously

  • Thrives in a collaborative, mission-driven environment

  • Balances strategic thinking with strong execution skills

  • Is energized by relationship-building and donor engagement

This role is well suited for someone who enjoys connecting data, donor motivations, and compelling communications to drive meaningful fundraising results.

What You'll Do

Annual Fund & Campaign Management

  • Serve as the primary relationship manager for donors in the Kuza and Nguzo Giving Circles ($1,250–$10,000 annually), building personal relationships through in-person meetings, phone calls, and ongoing conversation, and leading direct (one-on-one) solicitation of these donors.

  • Conduct regular donor visits — traveling as needed — to meet with current and prospective donors face-to-face, and represent Kakenya's Dream at donor events, community gatherings, and other external engagements.

  • Manage a portfolio of donors, personally cultivating and soliciting gifts up to $25,000 through direct, in-person and phone engagement.

  • Lead the planning, execution, and evaluation of annual giving campaigns, including annual appeals (e.g., Spring Appeal, Back to School Appeal, Annual Appeal), and monthly giving initiatives.

  • Manage peer-to-peer campaigns and crowdfunding efforts.

  • Develop and lead a Middle Donor Plan and Recurring Donor Plan, including a mid-level donor stewardship funnel focused on upgrading donors — designing and executing in-person cultivation activities, one-on-one meetings, and other stewardship touchpoints.

  • Lead and develop Giving Circle engagement and donor cultivation efforts.

  • Identify and personally cultivate prospective donors, including conducting prospect research to inform outreach for your own portfolio.

  • Join the President, Director of Development, and Board members in cultivation meetings to support engagement of major donors and other prospects.

  • Design donor engagement events and relationship-building activities.

  • Support the President, Director of Development, Board, and other staff in their own donor meetings, solicitation calls, and stewardship activities.

Grants & Institutional Fundraising

  • Build and maintain positive relationships with organizational funders through regular meetings, calls, and site visits, overseeing a portfolio of $5,000+ grantors.

  • Represent Kakenya's Dream in meetings, calls, and check-ins with foundation program officers and grant managers throughout the funding cycle.

  • Draft grant proposals, letters of inquiry, reports, and other institutional fundraising materials.

  • Identify and cultivate new foundation, corporate, and institutional funding opportunities.

  • Participate in funder convenings, briefings, and site visits as needed, including occasional travel.

  • Coordinate with internal program and leadership stakeholders to gather the outcomes data, budgets, and supporting content needed for proposals and reports.

  • Support development of a strong institutional funding pipeline aligned with organizational priorities.

  • Partner with the Director of Development and President to advance institutional fundraising strategies.

Collaboration & Organizational Support

  • Work closely with Development, Communications, Leadership, and Board stakeholders to support fundraising priorities.

  • Represent Kakenya's Dream professionally with donors, funders, and external partners.

  • Partner with the Development Operations & Administrative Coordinator to ensure fundraising data, donor records, and reporting needs support donor strategy and decision-making.

  • Support fundraising-related events and donor engagement activities as needed.

  • Contribute to a collaborative, solutions-oriented team culture.

Immediate Priorities (First 6–12 Months)

In the first year, the Annual Fund Officer will focus on:

  • Successfully managing annual fund campaigns — including and monthly giving — and donor communications.

  • Designing and beginning implementation of a middle-donor strategy, and building out the Recurring Donor Plan and stewardship strategy.

  • Expanding the organization's grant prospect pipeline and institutional funding opportunities.

  • Developing a deeper understanding of donor history, fundraising performance, and organizational priorities.

  • Managing a portfolio of donors, personally soliciting gifts up to $25,000.

  • Building collaborative relationships across Development, Communications, Leadership, and Program teams — including close partnership with the Development Operations & Administrative Coordinator on data and reporting needs.

  • Identifying opportunities to increase donor engagement and annual fund growth.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role will look like:

  • Annual fundraising campaigns are executed successfully and achieve revenue goals.

  • Grant proposals, reports, and institutional fundraising materials are submitted accurately and on time.

  • New funding opportunities are consistently identified and pursued.

  • Donor communications are timely, compelling, and aligned with fundraising strategy.

  • Strong middle-donor and recurring-donor stewardship strategies are in place and gaining traction.

  • Donor and campaign insights are shared with the Director of Development to inform strategy.

  • Internal teams — including the Development Operations & Administrative Coordinator — experience strong collaboration and support.

  • The organization builds stronger donor relationships and sustainable revenue growth.


Requirements

Who You Are

Must-Have Experience & Skills

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

  • Minimum of three years of hands-on development/nonprofit fundraising experience, including approximately two to three years designing annual appeals and donor cultivation; candidates with less traditional tenure but meaningful, direct outward-facing fundraising exposure are also encouraged to apply.

  • Experience developing fundraising campaigns, donor communications, or annual fund initiatives.

  • Previous experience in donor cultivation & direct (one-on-one) solicitation in any capacity.

  • Strong grant writing and proposal development experience.

  • Exceptional writing, editing, research, and communication skills.

  • Experience conducting donor, prospect, or foundation research.

  • Strong organizational and project management abilities; ability to manage multiple priorities and competing deadlines simultaneously.

  • Previous experience managing or working within a fundraising database.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.

  • Positive attitude, sense of humor, and ability to work efficiently and effectively with a partially remote team.

Preferred Experience & Skills

  • Three to four years of experience designing and executing fundraising campaigns.

  • Experience working in a small, collaborative nonprofit environment.

  • International experience or perspective, especially related to East Africa, education, violence against women/girls, and/or empowering girls.

Mindset & Work Style

The ideal candidate will be:

  • Curious and resourceful

  • Highly organized and self-directed

  • Collaborative and relationship-oriented

  • Strategic while remaining hands-on

  • Adaptable in a fast-moving environment

  • Motivated by mission-driven work and measurable impact

What Makes This Role Exciting

This is an opportunity to help shape the future growth of a mission-driven organization with global impact. You will play a meaningful role in expanding donor engagement, securing institutional support, and advancing fundraising strategies that directly support girls' education and empowerment in Kenya.

You will join a passionate, collaborative team that believes in the power of education to transform lives and communities while helping build the resources necessary to fuel that vision.


Benefits

Benefits

Employer paid health, vision, dental, life, short term & long term disability, retirement plan match, generous paid time off plan.
How to Apply

A cover letter is required, along with your resume — please describe your interest in Kakenya's Dream and your relevant fundraising experience.

jobs.description:
Who we are

Aselo is an open source, cloud-based contact center for helplines. Our platform gives mission-driven organizations that operate crisis response hotlines the tools to meet people wherever they reach out — voice, SMS, webchat, and social media — without the cost or complexity of commercial call center software. Aselo currently works with 25 organizations across 19 countries supporting issues from mental health to gender-based violence to child abuse, and more. We build the technology that empowers crisis counselors to provide empathetic support, and we keep it affordable for nonprofit budgets.

We also partner closely with Crisis Text Line so that helplines can access a complementary set of solutions through a single relationship.

The Opportunity

The Aselo Partnerships Lead will grow this worldwide impact by bringing more helplines onto the platform. This is a sales role, but the context is nonprofit, and that shapes the work. While growing revenue is essential, the central goal is always real-world impact through partnership and collaboration. Success looks like patient, well-informed relationship building and an honest read on whether Aselo is the right fit. If you like the mix of consultative selling, market analysis, and long-term customer relationships, and you want that work pointed at a social mission, this role will suit you.

What You’ll Do

Aselo is a fast-moving, growing team with a big vision and a critical mission. To serve our mission and vision, each role must be agile and flexible to meet the needs of the business, aligning daily work with business priorities as defined by managers and team leaders.

Outbound Sales and Business Development

  • Represent Aselo at conferences: run the booth, give live demos, and form new connections.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships across the helpline field, with prospects, partners, and vendors, both in person and virtually.
  • Generate leads through email, LinkedIn, referrals, and other channels you develop.
  • Find and adopt tools that make this work repeatable — reusable messaging, automation, and AI assistance where it helps — and improve the process rather than only working inside it.

Customer Success

  • Hand signed partners to our implementations team cleanly, with the context they need to start well.
  • Own ongoing relationships with existing customers: understand their needs and long-term goals, and surface co-fundraising, expansion, and growth opportunities.
  • Resolve customer issues that cut across teams, working directly with counterparts in implementations and support, keeping in touch with the evolving technical product.
  • Answer customer support questions as part of a rotation and as a backstop when the team needs cover.

Demos and Discovery

  • Present Aselo to new prospects while listening for what they actually need, and adapt the conversation as you learn.
  • Customize the Aselo demo account to match the customer type — for example, adjusting data forms — so prospects see something recognizable.
  • Develop enough technical fluency in Aselo's product to speak credibly to functionality, integrations, and configuration in customer conversations.
  • Work cross-functionally with product and technical teams to translate customer use cases and requirements into concrete business workflows for scoping.
  • Present Crisis Text Line solutions where they fit the prospect better, drawing on cross-training between the two teams.

Market Analysis

  • Build and maintain models of the markets Aselo serves, and keep them current.
  • Track industry trends and developments in the helpline technology space, and understand and clearly articulate where Aselo sits in the competitive landscape.
  • Evaluate potential new markets in consultation with leadership
  • Produce side-by-side comparisons of Aselo and alternative products.
  • Translate market trends and prospect conversations into product roadmap suggestions, and discuss them with product colleagues.

Internal Alignment

  • Work with Crisis Text Line partnerships staff for mutual support, to identify larger strategic themes, and support RFP responses.
  • Define and track sales and customer success metrics, and communicate them to internal stakeholders.
  • Provide Aselo’s Executive Director with input on partnership goals and targets, and own delivery against them once agreed.

Quotes and Pricing

  • Assemble quotes based on our pricing frameworks.
  • Propose changes to those frameworks as you learn what the market will bear.
  • Discuss quotes and pricing decisions with leadership.

Communications and Marketing

  • Build sales collateral — slide decks, flyers, and guides — tailored to specific market segments.
  • Support messaging on the website and social channels, including material that speaks to the needs of particular markets.
  • Run webinars and other informational sessions.

What You Bring (Required Qualifications)

  • 3+ years of experience in sales, business development, partnerships, or customer success, with demonstrated ability to manage opportunities from lead generation through discovery, proposal, negotiation, and signed agreement.
  • Strong consultative communication and relationship-building skills, including the ability to listen, establish rapport, assess fit, and tailor complex information to different audiences.
  • Ability to negotiate respectfully and empathetically with resource-constrained organizations.
  • Strong follow-through and organizational skills, including experience using CRM, reporting, or similar tools to manage relationships, pipelines, and performance metrics over time.
  • Strong analytical skills, including the ability to build market models, size potential markets, assess opportunities, and compare competing products.
  • Demonstrated creativity and resourcefulness in generating leads and using reusable content and/or automation to improve sales processes.
  • Technical aptitude sufficient to become fluent in the Aselo product and quickly learn basic tech tools such as Git commands and customer support tools. Prior experience with these specific tools is not required.
  • Ability to create clear presentation materials and working visuals, and to deliver effective demos, webinars, and presentations in person and virtually.
  • Comfort working primarily during Eastern Time hours while accommodating customers across a wide range of time zones, with the flexibility to travel approximately 20% of the time.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working cross-culturally.
  • Experience selling SaaS or other technology solutions to nonprofit, government, or public sector organizations.
  • Experience with helplines, crisis response, mental health, child protection, or another mission-driven service field.
  • Experience contributing to or leading RFP responses.
  • Experience managing both new business development and ongoing customer relationships, including renewals, expansion, or partnership growth.
  • Experience conducting competitive research, market sizing, or product-positioning analysis and translating customer feedback into product recommendations.
  • Preferred location within the Eastern Time Zone.
  • Proficiency in a language other than English (e.g., Spanish, French) is a plus.

This is a remote position.

Rockstaris hiring a full-time Front Desk & Customer Service Virtual Assistant on behalf of an animal welfare nonprofit serving a large rural service area.

This organization currently fields all inbound calls and email inquiries through a small front desk team, calls that are often emotional and urgent: found animals, injured pets, behavior crises, lost and found reports, and general questions about shelter services. Many callers are older or don't have reliable internet access, so phone remains their primary way of reaching the organization.

This role is not a message-passing position. The VA needs to actually resolve inquiries on the call itself using established scripts and procedures, not just relay information back to staff. As the organization launches new proactive programs over the coming months, this role also has real potential to expand into supporting those initiatives directly.

About the Client

This organization is an animal shelter serving a large, primarily rural community, taking in thousands of animals each year. They are shifting from a reactive to a proactive model of care, actively developing new outreach and prevention programs so their in-person team can focus more directly on hands-on animal care.

Their culture is mission-driven, organized, and deeply compassionate, with clear documented procedures already in place to support a new team member coming in.

Key Responsibilities

Phone & Customer Service

  • Answer all inbound calls related to lost and found animals, fostering, volunteering, general shelter procedures, and behavior or medical helpline questions
  • De-escalate emotionally distressed callers with genuine empathy and a calm, professional tone
  • Resolve inquiries directly on the call using established scripts and escalation guidelines, rather than simply taking a message
  • Direct calls appropriately across departments according to documented SOPs

Email & Administrative Support

  • Manage the organization's general inbox, responding to the same categories of inquiries handled by phone (fostering, volunteering, procedures, lost and found)
  • Maintain accurate records and documentation within the shelter management system (ShelterLuv), with training provided

Program Support (Growth Opportunity)

  • As new organizational programs launch, potentially support scheduling for community outreach initiatives, such as trap-neuter-return voucher distribution and owned-pet retention support

Tools & Systems

  • Sangoma (VoIP phone system)
  • ShelterLuv (shelter management software, training provided)
  • Email

Requirements

  • Strong phone-based customer service experience required
  • Genuine empathy and strong de-escalation skills, callers are frequently in emotional distress
  • Comfortable resolving issues independently rather than simply forwarding messages
  • Animal welfare background or a genuine love of animals is a strong plus
  • Comfortable learning new administrative software
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to follow documented procedures closely

Non-Negotiables

  • Strong empathy and de-escalation skills
  • Ability to solve problems on the call rather than just relaying messages
  • Reliable and consistent, this organization depends on the front line being covereda

Benefits

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience.
  • Opportunities for professional development and growth.

Description

MEDvidi is an AI-powered mental healthcare platform setting a new standard for safe, effective, and scalable psychiatric care in the United States.

We combine licensed providers with proprietary AI tools to deliver consistent, outcomes-driven treatment for conditions like ADHD, anxiety, depression, and more. MEDvidi's technology automates charting, follow-ups, and treatment planning, freeing providers to focus on patient care while improving efficiency and clinical quality.

As our Staff DevOps Engineer, you'll decide where our infrastructure goes next and take the rest of engineering there. This is a hands-on role in the truest sense: you set the technical direction, ship it with your own hands, and own the outcomes for reliability, cost, security, and developer experience across the company. You'll partner directly with our product engineering teams, embedded in what they're building, removing infrastructure friction, and shaping infrastructure around real product needs.

Why this role

  • Real ownership, end to end. You own outcomes, not tasks, including your metrics. Reliability, cost, performance, deployment health, and developer velocity belong to you: you set the targets and bring the numbers to the table proactively.
  • Technical leadership without the management overhead. Lead by expertise and initiative where the most senior engineers are also the ones in the code. You set direction and raise the bar while staying hands-on.
  • AI-native by default. Agentic AI is a first-class part of how we work. You'll delegate to autonomous agents, integrate their output into production changes, and help shape how the whole org builds with AI.

Responsibilities

  • Set and drive the technical vision and quarterly roadmap for our infrastructure proactively, with clear trade-offs and measurable goals.
  • Run and evolve our AWS + Kubernetes (EKS) infrastructure: cluster management, autoscaling (Karpenter), policy enforcement (Kyverno), and zero-downtime operations.
  • Own Infrastructure as Code end to end (Terraform, AWS CDK in TypeScript) and our GitLab CI/CD (reusable/shared templates, OIDC, self-managed GitLab).
  • Build and own observability that teams actually use (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, OpenSearch, CloudWatch; log pipelines, APM) a shared view of system health, not a dashboard nobody opens.
  • Keep blue-green deployments and health-gated automated rollback fast and boring; own zero-downtime PostgreSQL schema migrations (expand/contract) and CI migration gating.
  • Own security engineering in a HIPAA environment: secrets hygiene (rotation, short-lived credentials, leak scanning), PHI-aware handling of logs and data, and Vault managed as code.
  • Partner directly with product teams to remove infrastructure friction and improve developer experience by design.
  • Use agentic AI as a core part of your workflow, integrating autonomous-agent output into production.

Requirements

  • 6+ years in DevOps/infrastructure engineering, with strong systems fundamentals and solid Linux administration and troubleshooting (performance analysis, resource management, process debugging).
  • Hands-on AWS (EC2, EKS, RDS, ElastiCache, Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, API Gateway, ALB, S3) and production Kubernetes/EKS (cluster management, node scaling, policy enforcement; Karpenter, Kyverno, or similar).
  • Strong Infrastructure as Code (Terraform and AWS CDK in TypeScript) and CI/CD ownership (GitLab CI/CD: reusable/shared templates, OIDC id_tokens, self-managed GitLab).
  • Monitoring and observability in practice (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, OpenSearch, CloudWatch; log-shipping and error tracking/APM).
  • Practical security engineering (secrets rotation, short-lived credentials, leak scanning, PHI-aware logging) and HashiCorp Vault as code (KV, JWT/OIDC auth for CI, policy design).
  • Blue-green deployments with automated, health-gated rollback; PostgreSQL zero-downtime schema migrations (expand/contract) and migration gating in CI.
  • Containers (Docker, ECR, immutable tags, image lifecycle) and network/protocol fundamentals (load balancing, TLS, DNS).
  • Hands-on agentic AI workflows (Claude Code or similar): delegating to autonomous agents and integrating their output into production.
  • A developer-focused mindset, strong problem-solving for complex system issues, and strong technical writing (docs-as-code, ADRs, design docs via MRs).
  • Fluent Russian and English (B2).
  • Experience working effectively in remote, distributed teams.

Would be a plus

  • Experience in a regulated/compliance-heavy environment (HIPAA, SOC 2, or similar).
  • Configuration management (Ansible) for VM fleet management.
  • Node.js application operations (pm2, npm), our stack is Node.js + TypeScript.
  • GitOps tooling (ArgoCD, Flux) and deeper PostgreSQL database administration.
  • AWS certifications.

What we offer

  • High-impact environment: A chance to contribute to a product-driven company in the medical tech space.
  • Growth & compensation: Clear growth opportunities and a competitive compensation package.
  • Remote-first: Fully remote long-term collaboration under a B2B model.
  • Health & wellness: Health insurance after the probation period, plus sports & wellness compensation.

  • Time off: 19 paid vacation days annually, 4 additional wellness days each year, and paid sick leave for the first 5 working days.
  • Culture: Thoughtful gifts for key life events and offline corporate events.
