About Us

Pomelo places the best offshore talent with top brands, startups, and agencies across the globe. We enable hard-working and ambitious talent to work remotely from their home countries, while gaining exposure into how the world’s top companies operate.

About the Role

Our client is a culturally-conscious talent management agency that celebrates Black digital talent. They are seeking an Outreach Specialist to drive the offensive side of their sales engine. This role is responsible for everything they earn by going out and getting it: targeted LinkedIn outreach, casting submissions, brand and platform applications, and the daily care and feeding of our AI pitching infrastructure.

This is a volume role with judgment. You will move quickly across many opportunities a day, conduct disciplined LinkedIn outreach to brand and agency contacts, submit castings on behalf of our roster, fill out brand application forms, manage outputs from our AI pitching tooling, and keep the pipeline of net-new conversations alive. Warm replies hand off to the Brand Partnerships Specialist for negotiation and close.

Responsibilities

  • Run High-Volume Castings. Submit roughly 20 well-matched castings per day on behalf of our roster. Read briefs closely, choose the right talent, attach the correct materials, and write a short, persuasive submission note that reflects each creator's voice.
  • Drive LinkedIn Outreach. Conduct targeted LinkedIn outreach to brand marketers, agency leads, and decision-makers. Personalize meaningfully, track every touch, and convert connections into qualified conversations.
  • Complete Platform Forms and Applications. Apply talent and the agency to brand opportunities, accelerator programs, and platform-driven open calls. Treat every form as a pitch, not a checkbox.
  • Pitch with Story, Not Stats. Write short, sharp storytelling pitches that lead with the creator's narrative and category fit, not generic stats. You will be given a clear brand voice and brand examples to model from.
  • Manage AI-Assisted Pitching. Monitor, refine, and clean outputs from our AI pitching tooling daily. Ensure every machine-generated message reflects agency voice, accurate talent positioning, and current brand priorities. AI is your accelerant, not your auto-pilot.
  • Maintain the Outbound Record. Keep a clear, dated record of who has been pitched, what they responded with, and when to re-engage. Hand off warm replies to the Brand Partnerships Specialist with full context.
  • Spot Opportunity Lanes. Identify category gaps, brand whitespace, and seasonal moments where the roster is underexposed and proactively build pitch lists against them. Think in waves, not single touches.
  • Report Cleanly. Provide a clear weekly summary to the Principal: castings submitted, LinkedIn touches, applications filed, AI pitches sent, replies received, and any patterns worth attention.

Qualifications

  • 1–3+ years of experience in influencer marketing, PR, talent management, brand partnerships outreach, or a comparable outbound role.
  • Excellent professional written English. Native or near-native fluency required.
  • Strong short-form writing skills — you can write a 75-word pitch or LinkedIn message that reads like a person, not a template.
  • Demonstrated comfort with LinkedIn outreach at volume — targeting, personalization, and disciplined follow-up cadences.
  • Fluency with AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) used for outbound work. Bonus for experience with dedicated outbound tooling (Smartlead, Apollo, or comparable).
  • Familiarity with influencer casting platforms, brand application forms, and the broader creator economy ecosystem.
  • Organized, self-directed, and comfortable working from a daily / weekly output dashboard.
  • Reliable, professional remote work setup with stable internet and the ability to take calls when needed.
  • Overlap with US Eastern Time hours required.

Benefits

  • Competitive pay, always in US dollars
  • Work remotely from the comfort of your home
  • Health & wellness benefit
  • Paid holidays and time off
  • Performance and referral bonuses
  • Global exposure to the world’s best companies

jobs.excerpt: Join the Rest RevolutionThe world is wired and tired.
jobs.description:
Join the Rest Revolution

The world is wired and tired. It's plagued by screens, notifications, and the sense that you should always be doing ... something. But hey, you're reading this job application right now, so you probably know exactly what we're talking about.

So here's a bit of good news amidst all the noise: Hatch is a sleep wellness company that's betting on rest in a culture obsessed with optimization. While most technology is designed to keep you engaged, our devices use the science of habit formation to help people unplug, unwind, and recharge. Through genuinely enjoyable routines, habit building, and gentle guidance (no sleep scores or wearables here), we help people build healthier sleep habits and feel the difference in everyday life.

Ten years ago, we started with a mission to help parents navigate the complexities of newborn sleep. Today, we're helping more than 5 million people (and counting) take care of themselves and the people they love through the power of rest.

We’re open to candidates across the U.S. and Canada. However, please note that Hatch is based in California, so we just ask that you're available during PST/PDT hours.

The Opportunity

Hatch is seeking a creative, versatile Senior Producer to lead the production of premium audio experiences across our content portfolio - from meditations and sleep music to bedtime podcasts, audiobooks, and ASMR.

This is a hands-on creative role for someone who can move fluidly between disciplines. You might write or edit a meditation script, cast and direct a narrator, give a musician notes on a sound bath, assemble a rough cut in Pro Tools, or lead a project from early concept through launch.

You have exceptional instincts for pacing, tone, story, talent, and sound - and the ear to know when something is (or isn’t) working and why. You bring a strong creative point of view, but you’re equally comfortable collaborating, experimenting, and adapting your approach to the needs of a project.

This role will report to the Director of Audio Production.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead audio projects from concept through launch, owning the creative vision, production plan, and final execution.
  • Write, edit, and shape scripts across storytelling, mindfulness, and other audio formats, ensuring a strong, cohesive voice aligned with Hatch’s brand identity.
  • Source, cast, onboard and direct narrators, hosts, practitioners, musicians and other creative talent.
  • Develop pilots, test new formats, and evolve existing franchises across the Hatch content library.
  • Build strong relationships with talent and create an environment where they can do their best work.
  • Build and manage production schedules in Airtable, keeping projects moving without sacrificing creative quality.
  • Work with Director of Production to resource projects effectively across internal and external teams.
  • Collaborate early and often with Strategy, Development, Marketing, Design, and other cross-functional partners.
  • Direct recording sessions and talent, and jump into Pro Tools to edit, assemble, score, or lightly sound design work when needed.
  • Partner closely with sound designers, engineers, composers, and musicians to shape music and sound design.
  • Anticipate what a project needs beyond the audio itself, from the metadata to the marketing assets to artwork and launch deliverables, and make sure the right people have the right context at the right time.
  • Assemble rough cuts, give clear and actionable creative feedback, and ensure final audio meets Hatch’s quality bar.
  • Perform final quality control (QC) checks on all audio for platform and device playback.
  • Maintain a high and consistent creative bar across the Hatch content library while helping evolve what Hatch audio can sound and feel like.

What Success Looks Like

Within 1 month:

  • Get to know the team, our production workflows, and the Hatch content library
  • Understand what’s currently in production and what’s coming next
  • Take the lead on at least one active project
  • Identify opportunities to make our production processes stronger or more efficient.

Within 3 Months:

  • Independently lead projects from concept through delivery.
  • Deliver high-quality pilots, scripts, and audio.
  • Successfully launch your first project.
  • Regularly contribute new creative ideas and opportunities for the slate.

After 6 Months:

  • Develop new content that meaningfully strengthens and expands Hatch’s brand identity.
  • Help evolve existing franchises and identify opportunities for new ones.
  • Identify and experiment with new approaches to audio, sound, light, and production workflows.
  • Be a trusted creative leader and collaborator across the content team.

What You’ll Bring

  • 7+ years of hands-on audio production experience: Proficiency in writing, recording, directing, and editing high-quality audio. You know when to do something yourself vs bring in a specialist.
  • Strong Creative Point of View: You have exceptional taste and a proven body of work to back it up. You use that point of view as a North Star while adapting to the audience, function, and creative language of each project.
  • Excellent writing and editorial instincts. Regardless of subject matter, you understand tone, structure, pacing, and voice. You can make a script better on the page, and continue shaping it with talent in the room.
  • A track record of great casting and talent development: Whether your working with hosts, actors, practitioners, experts, influencers, or artists, you know how to find interesting people and get their best work - not simply direct them.
  • A strong musical ear. You’re comfortable giving informed, specific feedback on music-forward content, and collaborating with professional musicians, composers, singers, and sound designers.
  • A full-court view: You see a project from beginning to end and stay ahead of what it needs at every stage. You bring in the right stakeholders early, communicate the right context, and make sure both the content and everything surrounding it are delivered on time and positioned for impact.
  • A team player mentality: You make the people around you better, teach generously, give clear feedback, celebrate great work, and identify opportunities for others to grow. You believe that the best creative teams operate as teams, not collections of individuals.
  • A bias to action: You’re creative, organized, communicative, and willing to step up and lead without being asked.
  • Fearlessness and curiosity: You like learning new tools, testing unfamiliar workflows, and challenging the way things have always been done.
  • Fluency with modern creative tools: Claude, ChatGPT, Granola, and other AI tools are already part of your workflow - or you’re eager to make them part of it. You’re thoughtful about where these tools can make creative work sharper, faster, and more collaborative.
  • Exceptional communication: You know how much context people need and when they need it. You communicate clearly with creative collaborators, cross-functional stakeholders, and leadership without over- or under- explaining, and you delegate with clarity.

Why You’ll Love Working at Hatch

  • We’re a certified Great Place to Work
  • We help people sleep better. Our products make a real, meaningful difference in our customers’ lives
  • Our team is collaborative, fun, and full of brilliant minds, and you’ll work with leadership that truly values every contribution
  • We’re backed by world-class investors (and growing fast)
  • We’re a remote-friendly work environment. We practice what we preach to give our employees better balance and more flexibility

The Perks & Benefits That Matter

  • 100% paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for employees (80% for dependents, including domestic partners)
  • Meaningful equity. You’re an owner here
  • 401(k) match with no vesting schedule
  • 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave
  • 16 free therapy sessions (for you and one other adult in your life)
  • Financial support for family planning
  • Remote office and monthly internet reimbursement
  • Friends and family discounts on Hatch products
  • Exclusive discounts on travel, entertainment, and top retail brands

About Hatch

Hatch was founded in 2014 by entrepreneurs (and parents themselves) Ann Crady Weiss and Dave Weiss. Headquartered in Menlo Park, California, Hatch creates tech that helps you and your family get better sleep.

Hatch Sleep Clock is a contactless sleep tracker that provides actionable insights, personalized recommendations, and bedtime routines based on your unique sleep habits and preferences

  • Restore 3 helps you regulate your nervous system and tune into your circadian rhythm with unwind routines, science-backed sleep audio, and ambient lights
  • Hatch Baby helps parents soothe their little ones and create healthy sleep habits with expert sleep support, gentle sounds, and calming lights
  • Hatch Go includes ten soothing sounds in one portable package

We’re an equal opportunity employer and committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

Ready to Help the World Sleep Better?

We’d love to hear from you! Apply now and join us in making great sleep a reality for all.

jobs.title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
jobs.excerpt: We are looking for an experienced data platform engineer to own the event-streaming backbone behind the k0rdent-ai platform — the multi-tenant control plane for enterprise GPU infrastructure.
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced data platform engineer to own the event-streaming backbone behind the k0rdent-ai platform — the multi-tenant control plane for enterprise GPU infrastructure. Every cluster provisioned, every GPU-hour consumed, and every tenant action produces events that must move reliably from our services into analytics, billing, observability, and downstream systems. You will design and operate that pipeline end to end: the streaming platform itself, the connectors and change-data-capture flows that feed it, the schemas that keep producers and consumers compatible, and the automation that lets product teams onboard themselves without waiting on you. Working within an agile framework alongside engineering teams across the US, Europe, and India, you will make event data a dependable product surface rather than a best-effort side channel.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Design, deploy, and operate the production streaming platform on Kubernetes — cluster lifecycle, topics, partitioning and retention strategy, capacity planning, and upgrades.

  • Build and maintain change-data-capture and connector pipelines moving data between operational databases, the streaming layer, and analytical stores.

  • Own schema governance — a schema registry, compatibility rules, and versioning discipline so producer changes never silently break consumers.

  • Develop custom connectors, transformations, and stream-processing logic in Java or Go where off-the-shelf components fall short.

  • Build self-service onboarding so product teams can provision topics, schemas, and access through infrastructure as code rather than tickets.

  • Automate the platform with Terraform and GitOps — no manually configured clusters, no undocumented topic definitions.

  • Instrument the pipeline for production: metrics, lag and throughput monitoring, alerting, and dashboards that both the platform team and application owners can act on.

  • Enforce security and multi-tenant isolation across the streaming layer — mTLS, authentication, topic-level RBAC, encryption, and audit trails.

  • Guarantee delivery semantics that the business can rely on — ordering, idempotency, exactly-once where required, replay, and disaster recovery.

  • Partner with backend and SRE teams on event schema design, producer patterns, and failure modes; participate in on-call for the platform you own.

  • Mentor engineers on streaming architecture and raise the team's bar through design review and documentation.

Required Skills/Abilities:

  • 10+ years in software, data, or platform engineering, including deep hands-on ownership of a production event-streaming platform.

  • Expert-level Apache Kafka (or Confluent Platform/Cloud) — administration, tuning, troubleshooting, and capacity management at production scale.

  • Strong Kafka Connect and CDC experience — Debezium, JDBC, and custom connector or transformation development.

  • Proven schema-registry practice and compatibility management across many independent producers and consumers.

  • Solid programming ability in Java, Python, or Go — enough to build connectors, transformations, and platform tooling, not only configure them.

  • Strong SQL and relational database knowledge (PostgreSQL, MySQL, or equivalent), including replication and CDC mechanics.

  • Kubernetes fluency — deploying, operating, and debugging stateful workloads.

  • Infrastructure as code discipline (Terraform or equivalent) and CI/CD pipeline ownership.

  • Clear written English for design docs, runbooks, and asynchronous review across global time zones.

Must Have

  • Streaming: Apache Kafka or Confluent, Kafka Connect, Schema Registry, and stream processing.

  • Data Movement: CDC tooling (Debezium or equivalent), connector development, and pipelines into analytical stores.

  • Kubernetes Native: Kubernetes, Docker, and Helm-packaged workloads in production.

  • Automation: Terraform, CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or equivalent), and GitOps practice.

  • Data Stores: PostgreSQL at scale, plus at least one cloud data warehouse or search store (Snowflake, BigQuery, Elasticsearch, or equivalent).

  • Cloud: AWS or GCP — networking, IAM, managed Kubernetes.

  • Security & Observability: mTLS, OIDC/SSO, RBAC, and Prometheus/Grafana monitoring.

Nice to Have

  • Confluent certification, or contributions to Kafka-ecosystem open source.

  • Stream processing with Flink, Kafka Streams, or ksqlDB.

  • Event-driven architecture patterns — outbox, saga, event sourcing, CloudEvents.

  • Exposure to GPU infrastructure, AI/ML data pipelines, or telemetry at high cardinality.

  • Usage metering, billing, or chargeback pipelines built on event data.

  • Alternative brokers (NATS JetStream, Pulsar) and a view on the tradeoffs.

  • Go, for working directly in our backend services' producer code.

  • Data quality, lineage, or catalog tooling.

  • Compliance exposure — SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar audit support.

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science & Engineering or related field or 10 years related experience.

What does Mirantis offer you?

  • Work with an established Silicon Valley leader in the cloud infrastructure industry;
  • Work with exceptionally passionate, talented and engaging colleagues, helping Fortune 500 and Global 2000 customers implement next-generation cloud technologies;
  • Be a part of cutting-edge, open-source innovation;
  • Thrive in the high-energy environment of a young company where openness, collaboration, risk-taking, and continuous growth are valued;
  • Professional development and training;
  • Attend conferences and working groups;
  • Company outings, happy hours, hackathons, and tech talks;
  • Receive a competitive compensation package with a strong benefits plan.

We are a Leader for Container Management in G2 (#2 after AWS)!

Mirantis, an IREN company, is the Kubernetes-native AI infrastructure company, enabling organizations to build and operate scalable, secure, and sovereign infrastructure for modern AI, machine learning, and data-intensive applications. By combining open source innovation with deep expertise in Kubernetes orchestration, Mirantis empowers platform engineering teams to deliver composable, production-ready developer platforms across any environment—on-premises, in the cloud, at the edge, or in sovereign data centers. As enterprises navigate the growing complexity of AI-driven workloads, Mirantis delivers the automation, GPU orchestration, and policy-driven control needed to manage infrastructure with confidence and agility. Committed to open standards and freedom from lock-in, Mirantis ensures that customers retain full control of their infrastructure strategy.

If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can't wait to meet you.

Location Requirement

About the role

We are looking for a highly organized and detail-oriented Claims Support Specialist to join our team. This role provides critical administrative and operational support across the claims lifecycle, with a focus on compliance-related data collection, claims administration, reporting, and data integrity. You will work closely with claims adjusters, operations, and leadership, including direct outreach to customers via phone and email, to gather required information, resolve outstanding items, and ensure claims data is accurate and complete.

Please note that this is an hourly, overtime-eligible role.

  • Support claims administration by following up on and resolving outstanding items to keep claims moving toward resolution
  • Perform high-volume, accurate data entry and maintain claim records, ensuring data integrity across claims systems by reviewing, auditing, investigating, and resolving discrepancies in partnership with adjusters and internal teams
  • Support claim reporting activities by validating outputs and ensuring data shared internally and externally is accurate, complete, and submitted on time

Who You Are

  • Detail-oriented to your core, you catch what others miss
  • Comfortable and professional communicating with customers by phone and email
  • Highly organized and able to manage high-volume, repetitive tasks with accuracy
  • Process-driven, with a focus on consistency and standardization
  • Accountable and proactive in identifying and correcting data or compliance issues
  • Curious and willing to dig into discrepancies to find the root cause
  • Comfortable working with systems, data, and reporting tools
  • Effective communicator who collaborates well across teams and with external parties
  • Motivated and growth-focused, with interest in improving workflows and processes

Qualifications

  • 1+ year of experience with direct customer contact via phone and email, demonstrating a calm, empathetic approach to supporting customers through the claims process
  • 2+ years of experience in a data-focused, administrative, compliance, or customer-facing support role within insurance, compliance, or a similar environment, such as:
    • Claims support or claims data entry

  • Proficiency with Google Sheets, Excel, and similar tools used for reporting and reconciliation; experience with Looker, Power BI, or similar BI tools is a plus
  • Ability to manage high-volume work while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines
  • Strong organizational and problem-solving skills

At Reserv, we value diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences and believe that diversity in viewpoints and critical thinking drives innovation, first-principles thinking, and success. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage those from all walks of life to apply. If you believe you are a good fit for this role, we would love to hear from you!

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is looking for a Senior Financial Analyst to partner with our R&D organization. Samsara's R&D organization creates the industry-leading IoT products and features that power our customer experience. You will partner with our engineering leaders to manage Cloud, Cellular, and AI infrastructure costs, driving quantitative and qualitative analysis to identify cost optimization opportunities. You will help build the reporting and attribution frameworks needed to track and govern AI spend, support month-end close procedures, and drive forecast models that give our leaders and investors accurate guidance. The ideal candidate is highly self-motivated, analytical, and thrives in a fast-paced environment.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US or Canada. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. Youwill be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

  • Partner closely with leaders across our Software and Firmware Engineering teams to manage Cloud, Cellular, and AI vendor spend
  • Analyze financial results, prepare monthly and quarterly management reporting, and support financial review meetings with R&D and Finance leadership
  • Partner with Accounting on month-end close activities, cost classification, and reporting requests
  • Collaborate with R&D teams to drive AOP planning
  • Improve the accuracy and scalability of existing financial reporting and forecasting models
  • Develop new mechanisms, analysis, or KPIs to inspect business performance
  • Leverage AI tools to streamline financial reporting, forecasting, and ad hoc analysis workflows
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field
  • High aptitude and enthusiasm for complex problem solving utilizing financial modeling and analysis, including advanced Excel and Google Sheets skills
  • Experience at a high-growth tech company
  • Ability to work collaboratively and cross-functionally in a fast-paced, often changing environment
  • Strong communication and presentation skills; comfortable presenting to senior management
  • Proactive and highly organized self-starter, able to work independently under tight deadlines while maintaining attention to detail

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Familiarity with AWS cloud cost and general SaaS cost management
  • Proficiency with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Glean, Cursor, etc.), Databricks, and FP&A tools such as Workday Adaptive Planning (or similar planning systems) and NetSuite
  • Prior partnership with software engineering teams
  • Passion for building new models, processes, and mechanisms

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$81,600—$105,600 CAD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

We’ve raised over $90M, most recently completing our Series B, from top-tier investors including Accel, Kleiner Perkins, Initialized, Y Combinator, Felicis, and Altos Ventures, with backing from leaders at OpenAI, Google, Procore, ServiceTitan, Zillow, PlanGrid, and Uber.

Building the AI Infrastructure for Construction

  • Construction remains one of the largest real-world systems still operating on fragmented, manual infrastructure.

  • Every project in the U.S. moves through permitting and pre-construction workflows spread across ~20,000 jurisdictions, each with inconsistent rules, systems, and levels of digitization.

  • This creates one of the largest bottlenecks in the physical economy, delaying housing and infrastructure projects and costing billions in lost time and capital every year.

  • PermitFlow is rebuilding this layer from the ground up, using modern software and AI systems to automate permitting end-to-end.

  • Permitting is the gate every construction project's data passes through, giving us a route upstream into design, pricing, and feasibility, and downstream into procurement and scheduling, and a foundation to launch new products from.

  • We are still early, and the next set of products we build will define how far this category extends beyond permitting.

Role Overview

  • We're looking for an Engineering Manager, New Products to lead the engineering team turning our next product bets into shipped, revenue-generating systems.

  • This is a builder-leader role. You will own both people leadership and technical execution for products that don't exist yet, moving from hypothesis to pilot to commercial launch, often on a compressed timeline and with an incomplete spec.

  • You will report directly to our VP of Engineering and partner closely with our Product Lead, New Products to turn a market bet into an architecture, then into a working system a customer will pay for. Our VP strongly values hands-on technical leadership. The best-fit EMs here are comfortable making fast, defensible architecture calls with limited information, and just as comfortable running a team.

  • You will be expected to drive your own roadmap end-to-end from technical scoping and build-vs-buy calls through delivery and customer impact, ensuring what your team ships is fast enough to test a new market cheaply and solid enough to scale if the bet pays off.

What You’ll Do

You will operate across systems, people, and execution at scale:

  • Lead and grow an engineering team shipping new product lines from zero to commercial launch, raising the bar for ownership, quality, and execution speed

  • Build strong engineering culture through clear expectations, 1:1s, feedback loops, and career development

  • Partner with our Product Lead, New Products to translate an unvalidated market hypothesis into a technical architecture that can be built and tested quickly

  • Make fast, pragmatic build-vs-buy and scope calls that let the team test a new product cheaply before over-investing in it

  • Own technical execution from pilot through commercial launch, including the handoff to a durable, supportable system once a product line earns dedicated investment

  • Improve system reliability, observability, and engineering efficiency as a new product moves from pilot to scale

  • Play a key role in hiring and developing engineers who are energized by 0-to-1 ambiguity, and future leaders on the team

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for strong technical leaders who thrive in high-ownership, high-ambiguity environments.

  • 5+ years in software engineering, including 1+ year in engineering leadership

  • Direct experience shipping a 0-to-1 product or system in a startup or high-growth environment, ideally through to commercial launch

  • Strong system design and architecture fundamentals, with the judgment to build for speed of learning first and durability second, then know when to reverse that order

  • Ability to lead through ambiguity and turn an incomplete spec into structured execution

  • Strong communication skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • High standards for engineering quality, reliability, and performance despite compressed timelines

  • Deep technical fluency: comfortable engaging with code review, architecture, and tradeoffs

  • Bonus: founding engineer or early-stage startup experience where you built the first version of a product with minimal process scaffolding

  • Bonus: exposure to complex regulated environments (construction, logistics, government systems, etc.)

Why This Role Matters

This is not a maintenance role - it is a systems-building role at the foundation of a category being created in real time.

PermitFlow sits at the intersection of:

  • fragmented real-world regulatory infrastructure

  • high-friction physical economy workflows

  • emerging AI systems capable of automating end-to-end complexity

The products built here extend PermitFlow beyond permitting into the adjacent workflows construction teams already trust us with.

This role offers rare leverage: your technical calls will decide how fast we can test new markets, and your team's execution will decide which of those bets becomes a durable product line.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth company

  • 100% company-paid base medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees + healthcare FSA

  • 401(k) savings plan

  • Unlimited PTO and paid family leave

  • Home office & equipment stipend

  • Daily in-office lunch and dinner provided

  • Commuter benefits (pre-tax transit and parking)

If you want to build complex systems connecting software to real-world infrastructure and help define a category from the ground up, we’d love to talk.

Inside PermitFlow: The Team Transforming Construction Permitting

  • Identify knowledge gaps and develop intelligence leads to satisfy intelligence collection requirements of our customers.
  • Routinely monitor various open and restricted-access (underground forums, marketplaces, instant messaging groups) sources in order to uncover and understand motivations, goals, targets, capabilities and modus operandi (tactics, techniques and procedures) of cyber threat actors and groups.
  • Proactively track activities of and identify/attribute financially-motivated cyber threat actors.
  • Collaboratively work on special research projects, related to monitoring of cyber criminal infrastructure, malware campaigns, acquisition of cybercriminal commodities, repatriation of compromised data and others.
  • Communicate collection and research findings and associated assessments in clear and concise reporting in English.
  • Respond to customer Requests for Information (RFI) and ad-hoc requests from internal Intel 471 team members.

Experience & Qualifications:

  • In-depth understanding of cyber threat landscape and of associated matters is a must: risks and threats, actors and groups, motivations and goals, tools and capabilities, attacks and campaigns.

  • Hands-on experience in vHUMINT (virtual human intelligence) collection methods, including creation, development and management of personas in cybercrime-focused environments, gives preference.

  • Remote-friendly culture
  • Wellness programs
  • Employee recognition program
  • A variety of professional development opportunities
  • Inclusive culture focused on people, customers and innovation

jobs.description:
About the Job:

LaunchDarkly is seeking a Senior Manager, Global Payroll to lead and scale the company’s global payroll operations during its next phase of growth. This leader will partner closely with Accounting, Finance, People, Legal, IT, Total Rewards and external payroll providers to ensure payroll is accurate, timely, compliant, efficient and employee-centered across all countries and entities where LaunchDarkly operates.

The Senior Manager, Global Payroll will own the end-to-end payroll operating model, including payroll processing, controls, compliance, vendor management, reconciliations, reporting, systems and continuous improvement. This role is ideal for a strategic, hands-on payroll leader who is comfortable driving change across multiple functions and regions, staying close to complex details, and building scalable processes that support a growing global workforce.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the end-to-end global payroll operating model, including payroll calendars, standard operating procedures, data inputs, approvals, processing, funding, reconciliations, reporting and issue resolution
  • Lead US and international payroll operations across multiple countries, entities, pay frequencies and local requirements, ensuring each payroll cycle is accurate, timely and complete
  • Manage relationships with third-party payroll providers, EOR partners and local payroll specialists, holding partners accountable for service quality, compliance, deadlines and issue resolution
  • Establish and maintain strong payroll controls, review procedures and audit-ready documentation across employee data, tax withholding, deductions, benefits, equity, commissions, bonuses, off-cycle payments and employee changes
  • Partner closely with People Operations and Total Rewards to ensure new hires, terminations, transfers, promotions, compensation changes, benefits elections, leaves and other employee lifecycle events flow accurately into payroll
  • Partner with Accounting on payroll reconciliations, payroll-related journal entries, accruals, balance sheet accounts, cash funding and month-end close support
  • Partner with Stock Administration to ensure equity transactions, vesting, exercises, and related taxable compensation are accurately reflected in payroll and reported appropriately
  • Partner with Legal and external advisors on payroll tax, statutory requirements, registrations, wage and hour matters, audits, year-end reporting and changes in local regulations
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for complex payroll issues, investigate root causes, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners and affected employees
  • Lead payroll audits and year-end processes, including W-2s, tax filings, statutory reporting, reconciliations and other required employee and government reporting
  • Evaluate and implement/improve payroll systems, HRIS integrations, workflows and reporting to reduce manual effort, improve data quality and increase operational visibility
  • Partner with IT and business stakeholders on payroll system enhancements, integrations, provider transitions, entity launches and other initiatives that improve scalability and employee experience
  • Define and monitor payroll operating metrics, including cycle accuracy, timeliness, exception volume, issue resolution, provider performance, reconciliations and audit findings
  • Analyze payroll data and trends, prepare regular payroll forecasts and workforce-cost projections, investigate discrepancies, and deliver clear reporting and metrics to Finance and leadership
  • Improve the employee payroll experience by responding to questions, resolving issues promptly, and communicating clearly about payroll timelines and changes
  • Identify opportunities to use automation and AI-enabled tools responsibly to improve payroll operations, reporting, controls and employee support
  • Lead, mentor and develop payroll team member(s) and external partners, creating clear accountability, strong development paths and a culture of operational excellence
  • Serve as a trusted partner to Finance and People leadership by balancing strong governance with practical, business-oriented problem solving

Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of progressive payroll experience, including significant experience leading global payroll operations in a multi-entity organization.
  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, human resources, business or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. CPP preferred.
  • Experience managing US and international payroll across multiple countries, pay frequencies, payroll providers, EOR partners and local specialists, including service-level oversight and issue resolution
  • Strong knowledge of US payroll tax, statutory requirements, year-end reporting, wage and hour considerations, benefits deductions, equity, commissions and payroll accounting
  • Experience processing or reviewing bonuses, commissions, equity-related compensation, and other off-cycle or non-recurring payroll payments
  • Hands-on experience with payroll solutions (e.g. ADP) and a track record of leading payroll system implementations, migrations, integrations, or major system enhancements
  • Demonstrated success designing and improving payroll controls, reconciliations, audit processes, documentation and standard operating procedures
  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to investigate variances, identify root causes and communicate clear recommendations
  • Proven ability to partner cross-functionally and influence outcomes across Finance, Accounting, People, Legal, IT, Total Rewards and business leadership
  • Demonstrate sound judgment and the ability to communicate clearly when handling sensitive employee information and time-critical issues
  • Ability to move between strategic leadership and detailed execution with a high degree of ownership
  • Experience working across regions and time zones in a fast-paced, evolving environment

Pay:

Target pay ranges based on Geographic Zones* for Level M3:

  • Zone 1: San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle - $136,000 - $187,000**
  • Zone 2: Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago - $122,000 - $168,000**
  • Zone 3: All other US locations - $116,000 - $159,000**
  • All Zones inclusive of a 15% Bonus Target

LaunchDarkly operates from a place of high trust and transparency; we are happy to state the pay range for our open roles to best align with your needs. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.

Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. jobs.description:
Company Overview
ImmunityBio is a vertically integrated commercial stage biotechnology company developing next-generation therapies that bolster the natural immune system to defeat cancers and infectious diseases. The Company’s range of immunotherapy and cell therapy platforms, alone and together, act to drive and sustain an immune response with the goal of creating durable and safe protection against disease. Designated an FDA Breakthrough Therapy, ANKTIVA is the first FDA-approved immunotherapy for non-muscle invasive bladder cancer CIS that activates NK cells, T cells, and memory T cells for a long-duration response. The Company is applying its science and platforms to treating cancers, including the development of potential cancer vaccines, as well as developing immunotherapies and cell therapies that we believe sharply reduce or eliminate the need for standard high-dose chemotherapy. These platforms and their associated product candidates are designed to be more effective, accessible, and easily administered than current standards of care in oncology and infectious diseases.

Why ImmunityBio?

• ImmunityBio is developing cutting-edge technology with the goal to transform the lives of patients with cancer and develop next-generation therapies and vaccines that complement, harness and amplify the immune system to defeat cancers and infectious diseases.

• Opportunity to join a publicly traded biopharmaceutical company with headquarters in Southern California.

• Work with a collaborative team with the ability to work across different areas of the company.

• Ability to join a growing company with professional development opportunities.


Position Summary

The Associate Director, Global Outsourcing and Budget Management leads the operational delivery of clinical sourcing, contracting, budgeting and supplier-management activities across global clinical studies. The role translates functional strategy and standards into consistent, inspection-ready execution; manages RFP and contracting workflows, investigator-site budget frameworks, supplier performance and financial reporting; and leads staff responsible for timely, compliant delivery. The Associate Director serves as the primary operational subject matter expert and escalates material financial, contractual or supplier risks with clear recommendations.

Essential Functions

  • Lead day-to-day clinical outsourcing, contracting and budget-management operations across assigned programs and supplier categories in accordance with approved strategy, governance and decision rights.
  • Manage, coach and develop assigned staff; allocate work, monitor quality and timelines, provide performance feedback and build team capability.
  • Plan and execute RFI/RFP activities, including scope development, bid analysis, supplier due diligence and cross-functional recommendation development; escalate material selection decisions for approval.
  • Lead preparation, negotiation, routing and execution of MSAs, Work Orders/SOWs, Change Orders, vendor service agreements and consultant agreements in partnership with Legal, Procurement and business owners.
  • Manage contracting and change-control workflows, monitor cycle times, identify scope creep or unplanned exposure, and escalate material deviations or disputes with options and recommendations.
  • Develop and maintain study-specific investigator-site budget templates and negotiation parameters for domestic and international sites, ensuring Fair Market Value, coverage-analysis and billing-compliance requirements are applied.
  • Oversee site-budget and contract negotiations, payment terms, exception management, SOX compliance (US), and payment-related issue resolution; monitor performance and implement corrective actions.
  • Review CRO site budgets above FMV or within escalation pathways, develop and track CRO (ex-US) site budgets for oversight
  • Review CRO invoices with Clinical Operations for unit cost and/or pass-through items and provide feedback to accounting
  • Oversee the invoice audits for accounting, develop systems to track and record GL (General Ledger) coding for all non-PO invoices
  • Support trial and vendor budgeting, forecasting, accruals, reconciliation, audit and variance-analysis activities by maintaining accurate assumptions, commitments and supporting documentation.
  • Maintain portfolio-level visibility into active contracts, budgets, purchase requisitions, change orders and supplier commitments; deliver timely dashboards, analyses and decision-ready reporting.
  • Manage operational supplier performance through scorecards, business reviews, action tracking and remediation; escalate material quality, cost, delivery or relationship risks through established governance.
  • Implement and maintain SOPs, templates, controls and standardized processes for sourcing, contracting, budgeting, supplier oversight and billing compliance; support audits and inspections as required.
  • Serve as process owner and operational SME for relevant clinical financial, contracting and payment systems, including Veeva; promote adoption, data quality and workflow optimization.
  • Partner closely with Clinical Operations, Finance/Accounting, Procurement, Legal, Quality, CMC and other functions to resolve issues, communicate substantive changes and ensure aligned execution.
  • Performs ad-hoc and cross-functional duties and/or projects as assigned to support business needs and provide developmental opportunities.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, business, finance, healthcare administration or a related discipline required; advanced degree preferred.
  • 8+ years of progressive experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, CRO or related clinical-research operations, including clinical outsourcing, supplier management, budgeting, contracting or site payments required.
  • 3+ years of experience leading teams, people or complex cross-functional workstreams required.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting global clinical studies across multiple phases and managing RFPs, contracts, site budgets, financial tracking and supplier-performance activities required.
  • Experience with CTMS and clinical financial, contracting or site-payment systems; Veeva experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience with Fair Market Value, coverage analysis, billing compliance and domestic/international site-budget negotiations preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

  • Strong working knowledge of clinical development operations, supplier-management practices and contracting and budget-management workflows.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in RFP execution, bid analysis, contract and change-order negotiation, investigator-site budgeting and supplier-performance management.
  • Strong financial and analytical skills, including budgeting, forecasting support, accruals, reconciliation and variance analysis.
  • Knowledge of Fair Market Value, coverage analysis, CPT coding and applicable billing-compliance requirements.
  • Proficiency with CTMS, Veeva or comparable clinical systems and advanced Microsoft Excel capabilities.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities, establish operational discipline and deliver accurate work within defined timelines.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, problem-solving and stakeholder-management skills in a matrixed environment.
  • Ability to coach staff, improve processes, promote knowledge sharing and support a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
  • Sound judgment to resolve routine issues independently and escalate material exceptions with fact-based recommendations.

Working Environment / Physical Environment

  • This position will work on site or remote as noted in their offer letter.
  • Regular work schedule is Monday – Friday, within standard business hours. Flexibility is available with manager approval.
  • Ability to sit/stand in front of a computer for a long period of time
  • Occasional evening or weekend work may be required to support business needs.

This position is eligible for a discretionary bonus and equity award. The annual base pay range for this position is below. The specific rate will depend on the successful candidate’s qualifications, prior experience as well as geographic location.

National Market (all markets unless identified as Premium)

$162,000 (entry-level qualifications) to $180,000 (highly experienced) annually

Premium Market (Premium markets include Los Angeles, San Diego, San Francisco, New York City, Chicago, & Boston)

jobs.excerpt: About BlueprintBlueprint is a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with teams across the United States.
jobs.description:
About Blueprint

Blueprint is a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with teams across the United States. We help organizations turn complex challenges into meaningful outcomes by connecting strategy and execution across AI, cloud, data, product development, and emerging technology.

Our culture is built by people who care deeply about doing exceptional work. We set high standards, take ownership, and continually challenge ourselves and one another to be better. We work hard, support each other, and take genuine pride in what we deliver for our clients, partners, and teams.

At Blueprint, you’ll work alongside talented people with different experiences, expertise, and perspectives. You’ll have opportunities to take on meaningful challenges, expand your skills, and see the impact of what you build.

Bring your perspective. Raise the standard. Build what matters.

About the Role

We’re looking for an AI Response Labeler / Annotator with deep expertise in French and the cultural context of France.

This is an AI annotation and evaluation role, not a translation or traditional localization position. French expertise is an essential specialization, but it represents only one component of the work. You’ll evaluate AI-generated responses across a broad range of topics, tasks, and real-world scenarios. Much of the content, annotation guidance, and day-to-day work will be in English.

You’ll perform side-by-side comparisons of responses generated by different AI models and determine which response better meets the user’s needs. This requires strong analytical judgment, the ability to interpret detailed guidelines, and the consistency to apply those standards across a high volume of evaluations.

Successful candidates will be comfortable assessing content beyond language quality alone. You may be asked to evaluate factual accuracy, relevance, completeness, reasoning, instruction-following, clarity, safety, tone, and overall usefulness.

What You'll Do

  • Perform side-by-side comparisons of AI-generated responses and determine which response is stronger.
  • Evaluate responses for factual accuracy, relevance, completeness, clarity, reasoning, instruction-following, tone, and overall quality.
  • Assess content written in English, French, or a combination of both, depending on the assigned scenario.
  • Evaluate a broad range of content, including general-purpose questions and answers, web-search results, file-based tasks, image-based responses, content-generation requests, and single-turn and multi-turn conversations.
  • Apply French expertise when evaluating language, terminology, tone, regional conventions, idioms, and cultural context specific to France.
  • Evaluate the complete quality of a response rather than focusing only on grammar, translation, or language fluency.
  • Identify subtle but meaningful differences between responses, including unsupported claims, incomplete reasoning, missed instructions, unnatural phrasing, cultural inaccuracies, and differences in usefulness.
  • Apply detailed, scenario-specific annotation guidelines accurately and consistently.
  • Make independent evaluation decisions when examples or guidelines don’t provide an obvious answer.
  • Document decisions clearly and provide concise, evidence-based rationale when required.
  • Complete evaluations within established time and productivity expectations without sacrificing accuracy.
  • Maintain consistent judgment across a high volume of varied assignments.
  • Participate in training, guided practice, calibration sessions, qualification reviews, and ongoing quality-review activities.
  • Incorporate feedback and adjust evaluation decisions to remain aligned with team and client quality standards.

What You'll Bring

  • Native-level or professional fluency in French.
  • Deep familiarity with the linguistic conventions, regional vocabulary, idioms, tone, and cultural context of French as used in France.
  • Strong English fluency and reading comprehension, including the ability to understand complex prompts, AI-generated responses, and detailed annotation guidelines written in English.
  • Strong general analytical and critical-thinking skills that extend beyond language evaluation.
  • Ability to evaluate content across varied topics, formats, and task types.
  • Ability to assess factuality, relevance, reasoning, clarity, instruction-following, cultural appropriateness, and overall usefulness.
  • Ability to recognize subtle differences in meaning, quality, tone, and user intent.
  • Sound judgment when applying structured evaluation criteria to ambiguous or unfamiliar scenarios.
  • Strong written communication skills and the ability to explain evaluation decisions clearly and concisely.
  • Excellent attention to detail and the ability to maintain accuracy while working within established time expectations.
  • Ability to learn and consistently apply detailed evaluation frameworks.
  • Ability to work independently while remaining aligned with shared quality standards.
  • Comfort performing repetitive, detail-oriented work for extended periods while maintaining focus, accuracy and consistent judgement.
  • Ability to receive feedback, recalibrate decisions, and adapt as evaluation guidelines evolve.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience performing side-by-side labeling, annotation, comparative content evaluation, or quality assessment.
  • Experience evaluating AI-generated responses or contributing to model-quality assessment.
  • Experience with data labeling or annotation.
  • Experience evaluating search relevance, content quality, factual accuracy, or user-facing digital experiences.
  • Experience working with detailed guidelines, rubrics, or structured decision-making frameworks.

Work Pace and Productivity Expectations

This is a highly structured and repetitive role that involves completing similar evaluation tasks throughout the workday. Candidates should be comfortable maintaining focus, accuracy, and consistent judgment while reviewing a high volume of AI-generated content.

Most evaluation tasks are expected to take approximately 15 minutes, and employees are generally expected to complete a minimum of 25 tasks per day. Some tasks may take more or less time depending on their complexity.

Success in this role requires balancing productivity with quality. Employees must meet established daily expectations while carefully applying annotation guidelines and providing accurate, well-supported evaluation decisions.

Training and Qualification

All new hires must successfully complete a structured onboarding and qualification program before beginning production work.

The program includes training sessions, guided practice exercises, calibration against established quality benchmarks, and a formal qualification review.

Training is intended to establish consistent evaluation judgment across the team. Language fluency alone will not be sufficient to qualify. Employees must also demonstrate the ability to evaluate broader response quality, follow detailed annotation guidelines, explain their decisions, and complete work within the expected timeframe.

Employees will continue to receive feedback, quality reviews, and calibration support after entering production.

Compensation

We offer competitive compensation aligned with local market conditions and experience.

The estimated compensation range is $14.42–$16.83 USD per hour. The estimated full-time monthly equivalent is $2,500–$2,916.67 USD per month.

Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, and internal equity.

Location and Employment Structure

Ecuador

This role will be hired through an Employer of Record partner to support compliance with local employment, payroll, and benefits requirements. Eligible employees will receive benefits in accordance with local requirements and the terms of their employment.

During the approximately 30-day training and qualification period, employees must work from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Pacific Time. After successfully completing training, employees may work standard business hours within their local time zone.

Benefits

Blueprint believes that healthy, supported employees do their best work. Eligible employees have access to a comprehensive benefits package that may include:

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
  • 401(k) retirement plan

Benefits and eligibility may vary based on role, employment status, and location.

Yellow Card is the largest licensed Stablecoin-based infrastructure provider operating across over 60 countries. Yellow Card operates with a substantial global team spanning 24 countries. This workforce is characterized by its linguistic diversity, with collective speaking of over 25 languages, underscoring the company’s extensive international reach.

This is a hands-on treasury role sitting at the centre of how Yellow Card moves money. You will be responsible for making sure liquidity is where it needs to be, in the right currency, across our banks, liquidity providers, and offshore accounts, so that payouts, settlements, and trades are never held up for lack of funds. Day to day, that means moving capital between accounts, executing wires and stablecoin trades, and reacting fast when a payment is blocked because an account has run dry. You will report to the Head of Liquidity & Custody and work alongside the team's Liquidity and Pricing Specialist, who owns rate-setting and forecasting; this role owns execution, getting the money where it needs to be, accurately and on time.

What You'll Do

  • Execute offshore and local fund movements between Yellow Card's banks and liquidity providers to keep accounts funded for USD, EUR, GBP and other local-currency payouts.
  • Monitor account balances daily across banks and liquidity providers, and top up accounts proactively rather than waiting for a payment to be blocked.
  • Initiate wires, ACH, and SWIFT transfers across our banking partners within approval limits.
  • Trade with liquidity providers to convert stablecoin to fiat (and fiat to stablecoin) to rebalance exposure and fund payouts, locking rates directly with liquidity provider trading desks where needed.
  • Assist with liquidity movements, planning and projections, and the management of capital cycles and repayments.

Banking & Liquidity Partner Relationships:

Former Admissions Officer (Account Manager)

Full-time | Remote

Who We Are

Prepory is a premier college admissions counseling company. Our innovative, holistic approach is reshaping how students apply to college, find their fit, and earn admission to their dream schools. We've guided more than 20,000 students across 80+ countries, and we routinely help our students earn admission to the nation's most selective colleges and universities.

Through our college admissions practice, we work one-on-one with students from as early as 8th grade, helping them build an intentional extracurricular profile, craft compelling essays, and navigate every step of the application process. We hold ourselves to an excellent record of success by gearing our services to genuinely counsel the students, families, and institutions we serve.

About This Role

The Former Admissions Officer (Account Manager) is the person our parents hear from most. You'll own the relationship between Prepory and the parents and guardians of the students we serve, from the orientation calls through final admissions decisions, and you'll make sure the experience a family signed up for is the experience they actually get.

This is a client-facing, relationship-driven role. You'll run new student orientations and parent check-in meetings, serve as the escalation point when a family's expectations and a coach's approach fall out of alignment, and mentor our college admissions coaches on how to navigate hard conversations and complicated family dynamics. When a family is ready to add programming or re-enroll for another year, you'll be the person they trust enough to ask.

You'll also maintain a cohort of up to 15 students. That caseload is deliberately small, because the majority of your hours belong to client success. Coaching a few students keeps you close to the advising experience you represent to parents every day.

You'll report to our Client Success Director and work alongside our Program Directors, Program Managers, Enrollment team, and coaching team.

What You'll Do

Own the family relationship

  • Conduct new student orientation sessions that set clear expectations for the program and each family's role in it.
  • Run parent check-in meetings alongside the student's coach, translating student progress into terms families understand and can act on.
  • Communicate proactively with parents and guardians so concerns surface early, while there's still time to solve them.
  • Serve as the point of escalation for families whose expectations, needs, or dynamics call for a steadier hand, and know when to bring in the Client Success Director.
  • Handle difficult conversations with disappointed or anxious families directly, calmly, and with a solutions-oriented attitude.

Support and protect the coaching relationship

  • Serve as the point of contact and escalation for college admissions coaches navigating client concerns, expectations, and family dynamics.
  • Mentor coaches on client communication, individualized student needs, and the situations that don't have a playbook.
  • Collaborate with coaches and program leadership to adjust programming when a student's needs change.

Grow the relationship

  • Recognize when a family is ready for more, and introduce the Prepory programming that fits: college tours, UK admissions support, graduate and professional school admissions, and enrichment and research planning.
  • Own re-enrollments for the families you serve, and carry the commercial conversation with the same care you bring to every other conversation.
  • Champion referral and review strategies, including mentoring coaches on leveraging their relationship with families to drive positive reviews and referrals to friends and family.

Coach a cohort of up to 15 students

  • Conduct regular one-on-one advising sessions with your students, from profile building through final decisions.
  • Advise students through the writing process for personal statements, supplemental essays, and résumés, providing meaningful, actionable feedback.
  • Track each student's deadlines and assign tasks between sessions to keep them on pace.
  • Help students research and build a balanced college list that reflects their academic and professional interests.

What You Bring

  • Admissions knowledge you can draw on in real time. You'll be on live calls with families who ask hard, specific questions. You need to answer most of them with confidence, and recognize the rest quickly enough to say you'll follow up rather than guess.
  • Composure with any family in the room. Orientations and check-ins put you in front of every kind of parent, from the entirely hands-off to the deeply anxious.
  • Real comfort with the commercial side of the work. We are looking for someone who is excited when a conversation turns to renewals, add-on programming, or enrolling a second child, and who treats it as the natural extension of a relationship they've earned.
  • Availability to work at least one evening per week and 12 Saturdays or Sundays per year.
  • Impeccable listening, speaking, writing, and grammar skills, along with excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • The ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-moving environment, including peak season, when orientations, check-ins, and application deadlines all land at once.

Qualifications of Our Ideal Candidate

  • Graduated from a selective or highly-selective college or university (top-50 national university or top-20 liberal arts college preferred).
  • Three or more years of experience in college admissions, admissions consulting, or a closely related field. Experience inside an admissions office is a strong plus.
  • Detailed, current knowledge of the U.S. college admissions process, and a willingness to stay current as it changes.
  • Experience in customer success, client engagement, account management, or consultative sales.
  • Experience mentoring, coaching, or developing other people, formally or informally.
  • Extremely detail- and goal-oriented, with the ability to work independently in a high-velocity, unstructured environment.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Starting annual base salary: $58,679.51
  • This role is commission-eligible. Earning 4% commission on new enrollments, re-enrollments, and add-on programming.
  • Unlimited paid time off.
  • 11 paid holidays: Martin Luther King Jr. Day, Memorial Day, Juneteenth, Independence Day, Labor Day, Veterans Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve, Christmas Day, New Year's Eve, and New Year's Day
  • Prepory pays $285.22 per month towards your company PPO health insurance plan.
  • Prepory pays 100% towards our company dental, vision, and life insurance plans.
  • Performance-based holiday bonuses each year.
  • Two employee annual retreats with opportunities to travel to various locations and participate in team building activities.

jobs.description:
About the Program:

Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.
Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program.
We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.

Apprenticeship Requirements:

This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:
Interested in creative tech career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design
Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables
Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules
Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work

Apprenticeship Program Learnings:

Build digital products and services 0-1
Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice
Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights
Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution
Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea
Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution
Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options
Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.

How to Apply:

The application takes a few minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your resume. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply- we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.
You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort. Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status. If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.

Ce poste combine les rôles d'Agent de service à la clientèle et de Spécialiste en apprentissage, nécessitant de la flexibilité pour répondre aux exigences de formation. Tâches et responsabilités essentielles en période de formation :

Respect des politiques de Foundever en matière d'éthique et d'intégrité.

Diriger, inspirer et fournir un accompagnement et une rétroaction positifs et constructifs aux apprenants.

Animer le contenu de manière à s'assurer que les apprenants sont activement engagés et participent au processus d'apprentissage.

Documenter et traiter les problèmes d'assiduité, de conformité aux horaires, de rendement et de comportement, et savoir quand les escalader à un gestionnaire ou aux ressources humaines, par exemple lorsqu'une mesure disciplinaire est nécessaire.

Responsable de s'assurer que tous les employés qui terminent la formation en classe et la formation en cours d'emploi sont en mesure de gérer efficacement les interactions avec les clients, en créant une satisfaction positive de la clientèle et une fidélité à la marque, tout en respectant les exigences contractuelles de conformité et de mesures de performance.
